spiaggia-di-sabaudia.sunbeds: Lido sets of an umbrella and two loungers about EUR 30-35; free areas too.
spiaggia-di-sabaudia.note: Dunes belong to Circeo National Park. Private parking shuttles run.

platja-de-lloret.access: Easy to reach from Lloret de Mar, on foot or by short drive.
platja-de-lloret.parking: Paid underground parking in town; limited street parking.
platja-de-lloret.sunbeds: Sunbeds, showers, bars, water sports and lifeguards in season.
platja-de-lloret.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
platja-de-lloret.note: For a quieter swim, walk to the small coves at either end of the bay.

platja-gran-tossa-de-mar.parking: Hard in summer. A nearby car park is reported at EUR 4 per hour; otherwise park outside the centre and walk.
platja-gran-tossa-de-mar.sunbeds: Sunbed hire is listed by the tourist board, but one visitor saw few rental spots.
platja-gran-tossa-de-mar.food: Bars and restaurants along the promenade.
platja-gran-tossa-de-mar.note: Very busy in summer but there is usually room for a towel.

playa-de-peniscola.access: Easy; flat sand about 5.5 km long.
playa-de-peniscola.sunbeds: Sun loungers and umbrellas for rent.
playa-de-peniscola.food: Beach bars and restaurants along the promenade.
playa-de-peniscola.note: Blue Flag beach running from the castle toward Benicarlo.

playa-de-les-marines-denia.access: Easy to reach from Denia, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-les-marines-denia.parking: Free parking along the road behind the beach.
playa-de-les-marines-denia.sunbeds: Sunbeds, showers, beach bars and lifeguards in season.
playa-de-les-marines-denia.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-les-marines-denia.note: Go in June or September for space, as August fills the main sections.

playa-del-arenal-javea.access: Flat town beach with a promenade.
playa-del-arenal-javea.parking: Parking listed; capacity and cost not confirmed
playa-del-arenal-javea.food: Beach bar and restaurants and bars along the promenade.
playa-del-arenal-javea.note: Blue Flag. Red Cross lifeguards from Easter with several towers. Showers, toilets, foot wash and disabled access.

playa-arenal-bol-calpe.parking: Parking garage reported nearby; cost not confirmed
playa-arenal-bol-calpe.sunbeds: Sun loungers and umbrellas for rent.
playa-arenal-bol-calpe.note: Blue Flag. Toilets, playground and lifeguards; reports differ on showers.

spiaggia-di-peschici.food: Lido bars and restaurants such as Baia di Peschici.
spiaggia-di-peschici.note: Details for the main public beach are thin; Lido Orchidea is about 2 km from town.

spiaggia-di-sanremo.access: Easy to reach from Sanremo, on foot or by short drive.
spiaggia-di-sanremo.parking: Paid parking in town; the train station is close.
spiaggia-di-sanremo.sunbeds: Bathing clubs, free sections, showers, cafes and lifeguards in season.
spiaggia-di-sanremo.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
spiaggia-di-sanremo.note: Combine a swim with a walk up through the old town of La Pigna.

spiaggia-di-marina-di-maratea.access: Easy at Marina di Maratea; beaches are spread over about 30 km of coast.
spiaggia-di-marina-di-maratea.parking: Parking not confirmed; a car is recommended on this coast
spiaggia-di-marina-di-maratea.sunbeds: Lidos and hotel beaches rent sunbeds; not confirmed for this beach.
spiaggia-di-marina-di-maratea.food: Bars and restaurants at the marina.
spiaggia-di-marina-di-maratea.note: Details are thin for this exact beach; check with the lido.

spiaggia-di-scalea.access: Easy to reach from Scalea, on foot or by short drive.
spiaggia-di-scalea.parking: Free parking along the seafront; paid near the clubs.
spiaggia-di-scalea.sunbeds: Bathing clubs, free sections, bars and lifeguards in season.
spiaggia-di-scalea.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
spiaggia-di-scalea.note: Visit in June or September to avoid the August crowds.

spiaggia-di-marzamemi.access: Easy from the village; free and equipped sections.

spiaggia-guidi-carloforte.access: Beach on San Pietro island, about 5 miles north of Carloforte.
spiaggia-guidi-carloforte.parking: Parking listed at the beach bar; details not confirmed
spiaggia-guidi-carloforte.sunbeds: Not confirmed; nearby La Bobba has a rental kiosk.

plage-de-sainte-maxime.parking: Free car park at the avenue du General Touzet du Vigier; hard to find in summer
plage-de-sainte-maxime.sunbeds: Mattress and deckchair rental at the beach restaurants.
plage-de-sainte-maxime.food: Restaurants serve lunch and dinner with feet in the sand.
plage-de-sainte-maxime.note: Lifeguard station June 12 to September 13 (2026), 10:00-18:00 in June and September and 10:00-19:00 in July and August. Showers, toilets and a water sports base.

plage-des-sablettes-menton.access: Easy to reach from Menton, on foot or by short drive.

plage-des-sablettes-menton.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.

plage-de-saint-jean-de-luz.note: Lifeguards from about 11 am from June to mid-September (hours vary). Showers and toilets.

plage-du-bon-secours-saint-malo.access: Short walk from the walled town of Saint-Malo.

plage-du-bon-secours-saint-malo.note: Tidal sea water pool with diving boards (about 3 m and 5 m), open in summer and free. Grand Be islet is reachable on foot only at low tide. Supervised beach in summer.

praia-da-figueira-da-foz.access: Wide, flat sand; it can take about ten minutes to walk from the promenade to the water.

praia-da-figueira-da-foz.note: The town claims Europe widest beach, a stretch of sand about 2 km long.

praia-da-vagueira.access: Easy to reach from Vagueira, on foot or by short drive.

praia-da-vagueira.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-da-vagueira.note: Swim only in the supervised areas, as the Atlantic currents are strong.

durres-beach.access: Easy to reach from Durres, on foot or by short drive.

durres-beach.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
durres-beach.note: Visit the Roman amphitheatre in the old town after a swim.

bibione-beach.note: Lifeguards and bathrooms; season about mid-May to mid-September. Calm shallow water.

playa-de-benicassim.access: Easy to reach from Benicassim, on foot or by short drive.

playa-de-benicassim.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-benicassim.note: Visit the old villas along the promenade and the Desert de les Palmes hills nearby.

spiaggia-di-levante-terracina.access: Easy to reach from Terracina, on foot or by short drive.

spiaggia-di-levante-terracina.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
spiaggia-di-levante-terracina.note: Visit the upper old town and its Roman temple after the beach, when it is cooler.

spiaggia-di-giardini-naxos.access: Easy; flat; mix of sand and pebbles.

spiaggia-di-giardini-naxos.food: Restaurants and snack bars at the concessions.
spiaggia-di-giardini-naxos.note: Water shoes help on pebbles. Recanati to the south is mostly pebble.

spiaggia-di-cattolica.access: Easy to reach from Cattolica, on foot or by short drive.

spiaggia-di-cattolica.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
spiaggia-di-cattolica.note: Visit the Aquarium Le Navi and walk the promenade in the evening.

spiaggia-di-caorle.sunbeds: Umbrella with two loungers roughly EUR 7-25 depending on the lido (general Caorle).
spiaggia-di-caorle.food: Chiosco Havana is a beach bar with terrace.

spiaggia-di-finale-ligure.access: Flat Ligurian beach with free and paid sections.

spiaggia-di-finale-ligure.note: Calm sea, good for all-day stays.

platja-de-cadaques.access: Parking in town is limited; Platja del Ros has a free parking area nearby.

platja-de-cadaques.food: Bars and restaurants in Cadaques town; Platja del Ros has a bar and showers.
platja-de-cadaques.note: The town beach is small and central; sources on facilities for this exact beach are thin.

platja-de-calella-de-palafrugell.access: Public car parks near the beaches were not found.

platja-de-calella-de-palafrugell.note: A cluster of small coves rather than one beach. The pebbly Golfet cove lies to the south toward Cap Roig.

platja-de-blanes.access: Easy to reach from Blanes, on foot or by short drive.

platja-de-blanes.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
platja-de-blanes.note: Walk up to the Marimurtra garden for views over the bay.

platja-de-salou.access: Easy to reach from Salou, on foot or by short drive.

platja-de-salou.sunbeds: Sunbeds, showers, bars, water sports and lifeguards in season.
platja-de-salou.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
platja-de-salou.note: Walk or cycle the coastal path to small coves on the Cap Salou side.

platja-del-regueral-cambrils.access: Easy to reach from Cambrils, on foot or by short drive.
platja-del-regueral-cambrils.sunbeds: Sunbeds, showers, bars and lifeguards in season.
platja-del-regueral-cambrils.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
platja-del-regueral-cambrils.note: Eat seafood at the Cambrils harbour restaurants after a swim.

playa-de-la-rada-estepona.access: Easy; flat beach beside the promenade.

playa-de-la-rada-estepona.note: Lifeguard and rental points usually run from 10:00 until late in high season. Old coast road is closed to vehicles.

playa-san-cristobal-almunecar.access: Easy to reach from Almunecar, on foot or by short drive.
playa-san-cristobal-almunecar.parking: Paid parking near the seafront; free spaces further east.
playa-san-cristobal-almunecar.sunbeds: Sunbeds, showers, beach bars and lifeguards in season.
playa-san-cristobal-almunecar.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-san-cristobal-almunecar.note: Visit the castle and Roman fish salting remains in the old town.

plage-du-touquet.sunbeds: Private beach clubs rent mattresses and umbrellas.
plage-du-touquet.food: Cafes and restaurants along the front.
plage-du-touquet.note: Sand yachting is a signature activity. Lifeguards in peak season. Beach length reports vary.

plage-de-collioure.access: Parking is the main problem; a limited lot on the south side of the bay. Arrive early in high season.

plage-de-collioure.note: Pebble beach between the church and the Royal Castle. Saint-Vincent next door has toilets, a restaurant and a lifeguard in season.

plage-de-cavaliere-le-lavandou.parking: Paid public car park with 200 spaces about 300 m away; authorised spots on Avenue du Cap Negre
plage-de-cavaliere-le-lavandou.sunbeds: Sunbed rental by concessions; free access overall.

plage-de-cavaliere-le-lavandou.note: Lifeguarded early June to mid-September. Windsurf and kitesurf. Reviews note crowding and no showers.

plage-de-cabourg.access: Easy to reach from Cabourg, on foot or by short drive.

plage-de-cabourg.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.

spiaggia-di-punta-ala.sunbeds: Not confirmed; the PuntAla Camp resort has its own beach club for guests.

spiaggia-di-punta-ala.note: Sources mostly cover the resort; check locally for the public beach.

sidari-beach.access: Flat, long sandy bay; the Canal d Amour is close.

sidari-beach.note: Blue Flag. Water sports such as banana boats and water skiing. Packed in peak season.

porec-beach.access: Easy to reach from Porec, on foot or by short drive.

porec-beach.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.

praia-da-costa-da-caparica.food: Ocean Beach Bar, Praia Princesa Beach Club and seafood places on Rua dos Pescadores.
praia-da-costa-da-caparica.note: Lifeguards during the summer season in daylight hours. Southern beaches are quieter.

hersonissos-beach.access: Easy to reach from Hersonissos, on foot or by short drive.
hersonissos-beach.parking: Paid parking in town; free spaces along the coast road.
hersonissos-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds, tavernas, bars, water sports and showers in season.
hersonissos-beach.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
hersonissos-beach.note: Rent a boat to reach quiet coves, or visit the nearby Cretan villages.

playa-de-moraira.access: El Portet is a sheltered cove.
playa-de-moraira.parking: Parking is limited; arrive early or pay
playa-de-moraira.food: Chiringuitos such as El Raco and restaurants.
playa-de-moraira.note: Blue Flag. Lifeguards in summer, kayak hire.

plage-de-saint-aygulf-frejus.parking: Paid parking at Esclamandes; free lots reported nearby but fill fast
plage-de-saint-aygulf-frejus.note: Esclamandes has four zones: family, naturist, kitesurf and dog. Showers, toilets and lifeguards in season.

praia-da-povoa-de-varzim.access: Easy to reach from Povoa de Varzim, on foot or by short drive.

praia-da-povoa-de-varzim.sunbeds: Beach bars, showers, surf schools and lifeguards in season.
praia-da-povoa-de-varzim.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-da-povoa-de-varzim.note: Take the metro from Porto and swim only where lifeguards are on duty.

platja-de-roses.parking: Free and paid parking nearby; paid mainly in high season
platja-de-roses.sunbeds: Sun lounger hire at neighbouring Salatar and Rastrell; main beach not confirmed.

playa-de-levante-santa-pola.access: Easy to reach from Santa Pola, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-levante-santa-pola.parking: Paid parking near the promenade; free spaces further along.
playa-de-levante-santa-pola.sunbeds: Sunbeds, showers, beach bars and lifeguards in season.
playa-de-levante-santa-pola.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-levante-santa-pola.note: Combine a swim with a visit to the Santa Pola salt flats and their flamingos.

playa-de-gandia.access: Easy to reach from Gandia, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-gandia.parking: Paid parking near the promenade; free spaces on side streets.
playa-de-gandia.sunbeds: Sunbeds, showers, beach bars, water sports and lifeguards in season.
playa-de-gandia.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-gandia.note: Visit in June or September for space, and walk the promenade towards the marina at sunset.

playa-san-antonio-cullera.access: Easy to reach from Cullera, on foot or by short drive.
playa-san-antonio-cullera.parking: Paid parking along the promenade; free spaces further out.
playa-san-antonio-cullera.sunbeds: Sunbeds, showers, beach bars and lifeguards in season.
playa-san-antonio-cullera.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-san-antonio-cullera.note: Walk up to the castle and the lighthouse hill for views along the coast.

platja-del-morro-de-gos-oropesa.access: Easy to reach from Oropesa del Mar, on foot or by short drive.
platja-del-morro-de-gos-oropesa.parking: Paid parking near the beach; free spaces on the hill streets.
platja-del-morro-de-gos-oropesa.sunbeds: Sunbeds, showers, bars and lifeguards in season.
platja-del-morro-de-gos-oropesa.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
platja-del-morro-de-gos-oropesa.note: Walk the coastal path to the small coves of the Renegado headland.

torrevieja-beach.access: Easy to reach from Torrevieja, on foot or by short drive.
torrevieja-beach.parking: Paid parking near the seafront; free spaces further out.
torrevieja-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds, showers, beach bars and lifeguards in season.
torrevieja-beach.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
torrevieja-beach.note: Visit the pink salt lake of Torrevieja and walk the long seafront promenade.

playa-del-moncayo-guardamar.parking: Easy to find a space early in summer; some car parks may charge

playa-del-moncayo-guardamar.note: Blue Flag. Lifeguards, toilets, rinsing taps and boardwalks.

platja-de-pineda-de-mar.access: Easy to reach from Pineda de Mar, on foot or by short drive.

platja-de-pineda-de-mar.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
platja-de-pineda-de-mar.note: Take the train from Barcelona and walk the promenade towards Calella.

platja-de-malgrat-de-mar.access: Easy to reach from Malgrat de Mar, on foot or by short drive.

platja-de-malgrat-de-mar.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
platja-de-malgrat-de-mar.note: Walk the river path at the Tordera mouth for birdwatching.

plage-de-canet-en-roussillon.access: Easy to reach from Canet-en-Roussillon, on foot or by short drive.

plage-de-canet-en-roussillon.sunbeds: Beach clubs, sunbeds, showers, cafes and lifeguards in season.
plage-de-canet-en-roussillon.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-canet-en-roussillon.note: Visit the nearby Etang de Canet lagoon for flamingos and kitesurf.

spiaggia-di-pescara.access: Easy to reach from Pescara, on foot or by short drive.

spiaggia-di-pescara.sunbeds: Bathing clubs, free sections, showers, bars and lifeguards in season.
spiaggia-di-pescara.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
spiaggia-di-pescara.note: Try the free sections at the north end for more space.

spiaggia-di-punta-aderci-vasto.access: Free parking nearby, then a long coastal path with sea views to the beach. A shuttle may run in season.
spiaggia-di-punta-aderci-vasto.parking: Free parking near the reserve; best at the eastern end by Porto di Vasto
spiaggia-di-punta-aderci-vasto.food: No restaurant on the beach; a snack corner at nearby Punta Penna and restaurants in Vasto.
spiaggia-di-punta-aderci-vasto.note: Inside the Punta Aderci nature reserve; bring food, water and an umbrella. Part of the Costa dei Trabocchi cycle path.

spiaggia-di-varazze.access: Easy to reach from Varazze, on foot or by short drive.
spiaggia-di-varazze.parking: Paid parking near the seafront; the train station is a short walk.
spiaggia-di-varazze.sunbeds: Bathing clubs, free sections, showers, bars and lifeguards in season.
spiaggia-di-varazze.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
spiaggia-di-varazze.note: Walk the old town lanes and the harbour, then swim at the free sections.

spiaggia-grande-diamante.access: Flat town beach beside the new promenade.
spiaggia-grande-diamante.sunbeds: Lidos along the front rent umbrellas and sunbeds (for example L Altro Lato and La Voce del Mare).
spiaggia-grande-diamante.food: Lido restaurants and bars serving Calabrian dishes.
spiaggia-grande-diamante.note: Details for this exact beach are thin; several lidos operate along the coast.

kardamena-beach-kos.access: Easy to reach from Kardamena, on foot or by short drive.
kardamena-beach-kos.parking: Free parking along the seafront; fills in August.
kardamena-beach-kos.sunbeds: Sunbeds, tavernas, bars, water sports and showers in season.
kardamena-beach-kos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
kardamena-beach-kos.note: Take a day boat to the volcanic island of Nisyros.

malia-beach-crete.access: Easy to reach from Malia, on foot or by short drive.
malia-beach-crete.parking: Free parking along the beach road; fills in August.
malia-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sunbeds, tavernas, bars, water sports and lifeguards in season.
malia-beach-crete.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
malia-beach-crete.note: Visit the Minoan palace of Malia in the morning, then swim in the afternoon.

vodice-beach.access: Easy to reach from Vodice, on foot or by short drive.
vodice-beach.parking: Paid parking in town; free spaces near the campsites.
vodice-beach.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds, water sports and showers in season.
vodice-beach.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
vodice-beach.note: Take a boat trip to the Kornati islands or the Krka waterfalls.

praia-atlantica-troia.access: Ferries run from Setubal (about EUR 9-10 return, reported); you can also take a car on the car ferry.
praia-atlantica-troia.food: A small beach bar nearby; restaurants within a few minutes walk.
praia-atlantica-troia.note: Lifeguards on the Troia beaches in season (reported).

praia-da-figueirinha-setubal.access: On the Arrabida coast road from Setubal, with a bus stop at the beach; summer car restrictions apply under Arrabida sem Carros.
praia-da-figueirinha-setubal.parking: Small paid lot in the bathing season that fills up in summer; one reviewer advises going by bike or bus.
praia-da-figueirinha-setubal.sunbeds: Sun loungers and umbrella rental in season; lifeguards, toilets and showers.
praia-da-figueirinha-setubal.food: Bar Mar and Figueirinha Beach Lounge is on the beach, with a terrace and Portuguese seafood dishes, open all year.
praia-da-figueirinha-setubal.note: Arrive by bus or bike in July and August and check the current car rules.

praia-de-espinho.access: Easy to reach from Espinho, on foot or by short drive.
praia-de-espinho.parking: Paid parking along the promenade; trains from Porto.
praia-de-espinho.sunbeds: Beach bars, showers, surf schools and lifeguards in season.
praia-de-espinho.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-de-espinho.note: Take the train from Porto and swim only where lifeguards are on duty.

arvanitia-beach-nafplio.access: Large car park up the road by the Land Gate, then steps down to the beach; a flat path leads on to Karathona.
arvanitia-beach-nafplio.sunbeds: Rented sun umbrellas and deck chairs.
arvanitia-beach-nafplio.food: A cafeteria on the beach (older listings).
arvanitia-beach-nafplio.note: Pebbles in the centre, rocky edges with small metal ladders. Showers and WC. Early or late is best for the Karathona walk in summer.

plage-de-la-grande-motte.access: Easy to reach from La Grande-Motte, on foot or by short drive.
plage-de-la-grande-motte.parking: Paid parking near the seafront; large free sections.
plage-de-la-grande-motte.sunbeds: Beach clubs, sunbeds, showers, cafes and lifeguards in season.
plage-de-la-grande-motte.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-la-grande-motte.note: Walk the dune boardwalks and the marina, then see the pyramid buildings.

cavtat-beach.access: Easy; at the end of the promenade in Tiha Bay.
cavtat-beach.parking: Parking hard to find near the beaches
cavtat-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds for rent; about EUR 15 for two and an umbrella (reported).
cavtat-beach.food: Several bars, cafes and restaurants close by.
cavtat-beach.note: Pebbles can be slippery, so water shoes help. Cash is useful.

plage-des-marinieres-villefranche.access: Paid car park right by the beach (about 259 spaces, EUR 2.20 per hour, free November-February, reported).
plage-des-marinieres-villefranche.parking: Paid car park by the beach, about EUR 2.20 per hour
plage-des-marinieres-villefranche.sunbeds: One private beach club rents sunbeds; the rest of the beach is free.
plage-des-marinieres-villefranche.food: Restaurants along the promenade and at the beach club.
plage-des-marinieres-villefranche.note: Public toilets and showers. Lifeguard season reported as mid-June to mid-September by one source and July-August by another.

perivolos-beach-santorini.access: Easy; long flat black sand beach.
perivolos-beach-santorini.parking: Generous roadside parking; no fee confirmed
perivolos-beach-santorini.sunbeds: Beach bars rent sunbed sets; packages often include drinks or food and vary widely.
perivolos-beach-santorini.food: Beach bars and restaurants such as FortyOne.
perivolos-beach-santorini.note: Black volcanic sand gets very hot. Water shoes are useful.

georgioupoli-beach-crete.access: Long flat beach beside the village.
georgioupoli-beach-crete.parking: Parking near the beach and along roads into town; fills by mid-morning in July and August
georgioupoli-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas, often offered by tavernas at little or no charge.
georgioupoli-beach-crete.food: Tavernas and snack bars along the sand and in the village.
georgioupoli-beach-crete.note: Lifeguards usually on duty because currents can be strong. Water sports available.

elounda-beach-crete.access: Flat beach; Spinalonga boats leave from the harbour.
elounda-beach-crete.parking: Parking at the beach fills in July and August; park slightly outside the centre if needed
elounda-beach-crete.food: A taverna on the beach; Elounda restaurants such as Lotus Eaters and Olondi.

kolymbia-beach-rhodes.access: Easy to reach from Kolymbia, on foot or by short drive.
kolymbia-beach-rhodes.parking: Free parking along the beach road; fills in August.
kolymbia-beach-rhodes.sunbeds: Sunbeds, tavernas, water sports and showers in season.
kolymbia-beach-rhodes.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
kolymbia-beach-rhodes.note: Walk along the shore to the quieter sections for more space and shade.

kamenjak-beach-premantura.access: Free for walkers and cyclists; cars pay a day pass (about EUR 10-15, sources disagree). Buses 26 and 28 run via Pula bus station.
kamenjak-beach-premantura.parking: Car day pass about EUR 10-15; free lot before the gate
kamenjak-beach-premantura.food: Safari bar near Mala Kolombarica; some beach bars take cash only.
kamenjak-beach-premantura.note: Protected cape about 10 km from Pula.

praia-do-martinhal-sagres.access: Short walk from free and paid parking; free spots fill early in high season.
praia-do-martinhal-sagres.parking: Free and paid parking; free spots fill early
praia-do-martinhal-sagres.note: Lifeguards in summer; shallow entry suits children. Sources disagree on beach length.

praia-da-conceicao-cascais.access: Easy to reach from Cascais, on foot or by short drive.
praia-da-conceicao-cascais.parking: Paid parking in town; train from Lisbon to Cascais.
praia-da-conceicao-cascais.sunbeds: Beach cafes, showers and lifeguards in season.
praia-da-conceicao-cascais.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-da-conceicao-cascais.note: Take the train from Lisbon and walk the coast path to the next bay.

praia-de-supertubos-peniche.access: Beach on the N144 about 2 km from Peniche; also reachable on foot via a bridge.
praia-de-supertubos-peniche.parking: Car park at the beach; a free spot at nearby Consolacao
praia-de-supertubos-peniche.food: Bar, restaurant and Banana Beach Bar nearby.
praia-de-supertubos-peniche.note: Supervised in summer. Several surf schools nearby. Also called Praia Medao.

praia-da-marina-vilamoura.access: Easy to reach from Vilamoura, on foot or by short drive.
praia-da-marina-vilamoura.parking: Paid parking near the marina; free spaces further out.
praia-da-marina-vilamoura.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds, showers and lifeguards in season.
praia-da-marina-vilamoura.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-da-marina-vilamoura.note: Walk the marina first for a coffee, then choose a quieter stretch along the shore.

praia-da-alagoa-altura.access: Easy to reach from Altura, on foot or by short drive.
praia-da-alagoa-altura.parking: Free parking behind the dunes; fills in August.
praia-da-alagoa-altura.sunbeds: Beach bars, showers and lifeguards in season.
praia-da-alagoa-altura.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-da-alagoa-altura.note: Visit on a weekday in June or September for the quietest sand.

plage-de-biscarrosse.access: Easy to reach from Biscarrosse, on foot or by short drive.
plage-de-biscarrosse.parking: Large paid car parks behind the dunes; cycle path from the town.
plage-de-biscarrosse.sunbeds: Surf schools, showers, cafes and lifeguards in season.
plage-de-biscarrosse.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-biscarrosse.note: Swim only between the flags and cycle the forest paths to the beach.

plage-de-carnac.parking: Roadside parking along the beach access road; free and paid reported
plage-de-carnac.sunbeds: Deckchairs, beach tents and pedal boats for rent in summer.
plage-de-carnac.food: A bar on the beach and terraces along the shore.
plage-de-carnac.note: Blue Flag. Supervised in summer, with a children s club, showers, toilets and accessible equipment.

playa-de-samil.access: Easy to reach from Vigo, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-samil.parking: Paid parking near the promenade; city bus from Vigo.
playa-de-samil.sunbeds: Cafes, showers, play areas and lifeguards in season.
playa-de-samil.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-samil.note: Take a boat from Vigo to the Cies Islands for an even quieter beach.

playa-de-la-fontanilla.access: Parking at the end of the access road from El Roqueo street; arrive after about 2 pm for easier parking.
playa-de-la-fontanilla.parking: At the end of El Roqueo access road; easier after 2 pm
playa-de-la-fontanilla.sunbeds: Sun loungers and parasols for hire in summer.
playa-de-la-fontanilla.food: Three chiringuitos by the water, usually open all summer.
playa-de-la-fontanilla.note: Lifeguards, showers and toilets in summer. The toilets sit by the car park. Width changes with tides.

playa-de-trafalgar.access: About 10 km from Barbate to the Trafalgar lighthouse beach near Los Canos de Meca.
playa-de-trafalgar.parking: Very limited in summer: one visitor parked at the far end of the village and walked about 45 minutes. Arrive early.
playa-de-trafalgar.food: Restaurants and open-air cafes on the slope above the beach, with sea views.
playa-de-trafalgar.note: A popular sunset spot; check parking rules with Barbate council.

playa-de-san-juan.access: Easy to reach from Alicante, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-san-juan.parking: Paid parking along the promenade; tram from Alicante.
playa-de-san-juan.sunbeds: Sunbeds, showers, beach bars and lifeguards in season.
playa-de-san-juan.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-san-juan.note: Take the tram from Alicante and walk the palm promenade at sunset.

spiaggia-di-maria-pia-alghero.access: Beach beside a pine forest, in the city of Alghero.
spiaggia-di-maria-pia-alghero.parking: Mostly paid in July and August (about EUR 1.50 per hour or EUR 10 per day); free spots easier in shoulder months
spiaggia-di-maria-pia-alghero.sunbeds: Loungers and parasols for rent; about EUR 45 for two in the first row (reported).
spiaggia-di-maria-pia-alghero.note: Pines give natural shade. Free areas exist as well.

spiaggia-di-lignano-sabbiadoro.access: Easy to reach from Lignano Sabbiadoro, on foot or by short drive.
spiaggia-di-lignano-sabbiadoro.parking: Paid parking near the seafront; large car parks in town.
spiaggia-di-lignano-sabbiadoro.sunbeds: Bathing clubs, sunbeds, showers, bars and lifeguards in season.
spiaggia-di-lignano-sabbiadoro.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
spiaggia-di-lignano-sabbiadoro.note: Walk the seafront in the evening, then visit the nearby lagoon by boat.

platja-de-sant-feliu-de-guixols.access: Easy to reach from Sant Feliu de Guixols, on foot or by short drive.
platja-de-sant-feliu-de-guixols.parking: Paid parking near the promenade; free spaces further up the hill.
platja-de-sant-feliu-de-guixols.sunbeds: Sunbeds, showers, beach bars and lifeguards in season.
platja-de-sant-feliu-de-guixols.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
platja-de-sant-feliu-de-guixols.note: Walk the Cami de Ronda coast path to the quiet coves north and south of the town.

plage-des-sables-blancs-concarneau.access: Family beach; the northern part is the most pleasant.
plage-des-sables-blancs-concarneau.parking: Free parking near the beach; some paid
plage-des-sables-blancs-concarneau.food: Restaurants and cafes nearby, several about 3 minutes by car.
plage-des-sables-blancs-concarneau.note: Supervised in July and August. Dogs are not allowed.

stavros-beach-crete.access: About 15 km from Chania on the Akrotiri peninsula, roughly 25 to 30 minutes by car; buses from Chania run in summer on a limited schedule.
stavros-beach-crete.parking: Free car park just behind the shore that fills in July and August; arrive before 10am or after 4pm.
stavros-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for hire along the main section (one visitor found them pricey).
stavros-beach-crete.food: Tavernas behind the beach in summer; sources differ on how many.
stavros-beach-crete.note: A sheltered, shallow bay that suits small children. The final dance scene of Zorba the Greek was filmed here.

plage-de-soulac-sur-mer.access: Easy to reach from Soulac-sur-Mer, on foot or by short drive.
plage-de-soulac-sur-mer.parking: Paid parking near the seafront; large free car parks further back.
plage-de-soulac-sur-mer.sunbeds: Beach tents, showers, cafes and lifeguards in season.
plage-de-soulac-sur-mer.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-soulac-sur-mer.note: Visit the old basilica in town, and swim only where lifeguards are on duty.

playa-de-la-herradura.access: Easy to reach from La Herradura, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-la-herradura.parking: Free parking along the seafront; paid in the marina.
playa-de-la-herradura.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds, showers and diving centres in season.
playa-de-la-herradura.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-la-herradura.note: Walk to the headland of Cerro Gordo for coves and clear water.

selce-beach-crikvenica.access: Easy to reach from Selce, on foot or by short drive.
selce-beach-crikvenica.parking: Paid parking in town; free spaces further up the hill.
selce-beach-crikvenica.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds, water sports and showers in season.
selce-beach-crikvenica.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
selce-beach-crikvenica.note: Walk the long seafront promenade towards Crikvenica at sunset.

playa-de-la-victoria-cadiz.access: Long flat city beach with a promenade.
playa-de-la-victoria-cadiz.parking: Street parking in surrounding streets; hard at peak times
playa-de-la-victoria-cadiz.sunbeds: Chiringuitos rent sunbeds and umbrellas; paddle boats.
playa-de-la-victoria-cadiz.food: Several chiringuitos line the back of the beach.

skala-beach-kefalonia.access: Easy to reach from Skala, on foot or by short drive.
skala-beach-kefalonia.parking: Free parking along the beach road; fills in August.
skala-beach-kefalonia.sunbeds: Sunbeds, tavernas, showers and water sports in season.
skala-beach-kefalonia.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
skala-beach-kefalonia.note: Walk to the quiet far end for space, and stay for dinner at one of the village tavernas.

agnontas-beach-skopelos.access: Easy to reach from Agnontas, on foot or by short drive.
agnontas-beach-skopelos.parking: Free parking by the harbour; limited in August.
agnontas-beach-skopelos.sunbeds: A few tavernas, sunbeds in season and a small harbour.
agnontas-beach-skopelos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
agnontas-beach-skopelos.note: Eat fresh fish at a harbour taverna and swim early before the boats arrive.

stegna-beach-rhodes.access: Easy to reach from Stegna, on foot or by short drive.
stegna-beach-rhodes.parking: Free parking near the beach; fills in August.
stegna-beach-rhodes.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, tavernas and showers in season.
stegna-beach-rhodes.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
stegna-beach-rhodes.note: Take a walk along the shore to the quieter end of the bay, and visit nearby Archangelos for lunch.

marmari-beach-kos.access: Easy to reach from Marmari, on foot or by short drive.
marmari-beach-kos.parking: Free parking along the access road.
marmari-beach-kos.sunbeds: Sunbeds, beach bars, water sports and showers in season.
marmari-beach-kos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
marmari-beach-kos.note: Visit in the morning for calm water, and expect small waves in the afternoon breeze.

glystra-beach-rhodes.access: Easy to reach from Lardos, on foot or by short drive.
glystra-beach-rhodes.parking: Small free car park near the beach; fills by midday in August.
glystra-beach-rhodes.sunbeds: Sunbeds and a small taverna in season.
glystra-beach-rhodes.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
glystra-beach-rhodes.note: Bring water and shade, and arrive in the morning for the calmest sea.

spiaggia-del-poetto-cagliari.access: Easy to reach from Cagliari, on foot or by short drive.
spiaggia-del-poetto-cagliari.parking: Paid parking along the seafront; city buses from Cagliari.
spiaggia-del-poetto-cagliari.sunbeds: Bathing clubs, sunbeds, beach bars, showers and lifeguards in season.
spiaggia-del-poetto-cagliari.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
spiaggia-del-poetto-cagliari.note: Take the bus from Cagliari and stay for a sunset aperitivo on the promenade.

spiaggia-di-velluto-senigallia.access: Easy to reach from Senigallia, on foot or by short drive.
spiaggia-di-velluto-senigallia.parking: Paid parking near the seafront; large car parks further back.
spiaggia-di-velluto-senigallia.sunbeds: Bathing clubs, sunbeds, showers, bars and lifeguards in season.
spiaggia-di-velluto-senigallia.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
spiaggia-di-velluto-senigallia.note: Walk along the promenade to the Rotonda a Mare and visit the old town for a late lunch.

spiaggia-di-portonovo.access: From Ancona by the Conero Link bus (about EUR 1.35, sold with the train ticket) or by car to a large paid lot with a free shuttle in summer.
spiaggia-di-portonovo.parking: Large lot reported at EUR 8 a day in peak season and EUR 5 off-peak, with a free shuttle every 15 to 20 minutes; check current prices.
spiaggia-di-portonovo.sunbeds: Beach establishments (lidos) operate in season; confirm sunbed prices locally.
spiaggia-di-portonovo.food: Lido restaurants serve seafood; try the local mussels (moscioli) at lunch.
spiaggia-di-portonovo.note: Go early in the morning or late in the afternoon; July and August are very crowded.

spiaggia-di-fontane-bianche.access: Flat bay of about 2 km between Avola and Siracusa.
spiaggia-di-fontane-bianche.parking: Ample; free about a 10-15 minute walk away, or paid lots
spiaggia-di-fontane-bianche.sunbeds: Concessions rent an umbrella and two loungers for about EUR 25-30 per day.
spiaggia-di-fontane-bianche.food: Lido bars and restaurants such as Lido Sayonara.
spiaggia-di-fontane-bianche.note: About 90 percent is private concessions; the free stretch is small and may have no showers or changing room. Seaweed at times.

baska-voda-beach.access: Easy to reach from Baska Voda, on foot or by short drive.
baska-voda-beach.parking: Paid parking in town; free spaces further back.
baska-voda-beach.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds, water sports, showers and lifeguards in season.
baska-voda-beach.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
baska-voda-beach.note: Walk the promenade at sunset and take a boat trip to nearby islands from the harbour.

bilin-zal-beach-lumbarda.access: Easy to reach from Lumbarda, on foot or by short drive.
bilin-zal-beach-lumbarda.parking: Free parking near the beach; limited in August.
bilin-zal-beach-lumbarda.sunbeds: A small beach bar, sunbeds in season and showers.
bilin-zal-beach-lumbarda.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
bilin-zal-beach-lumbarda.note: Combine a swim with a wine tasting in the vineyards around Lumbarda.

lovran-beach.access: Easy to reach from Lovran, on foot or by short drive.
lovran-beach.parking: Paid parking in town; free spaces further up the hill.
lovran-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds, beach bars, showers and a cafe promenade in season.
lovran-beach.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
lovran-beach.note: Walk the Lungomare coastal path towards Opatija for views of the bay.

opatija-beach.access: Easy to reach from Opatija, on foot or by short drive.
opatija-beach.parking: Paid parking in town; the Rijeka bus stops in the centre.
opatija-beach.sunbeds: Bathing platforms, sunbeds, cafes, showers and a long promenade.
opatija-beach.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
opatija-beach.note: Walk the Lungomare to find a quiet swimming platform away from the main beach.

playa-de-matalascanas.access: Easy to reach from Matalascanas, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-matalascanas.parking: Large paid car parks behind the beach; free spaces further out.
playa-de-matalascanas.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds, showers and lifeguards in season.
playa-de-matalascanas.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-matalascanas.note: Visit the Donana dunes by guided tour, and swim only where the lifeguards are on duty.

playa-de-islantilla.access: Easy to reach from Islantilla, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-islantilla.parking: Free parking along the seafront; larger paid lots near the resort.
playa-de-islantilla.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds, showers and lifeguards in season.
playa-de-islantilla.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-islantilla.note: Walk the boardwalk through the dunes and check the tide for the widest beach.

playa-de-regla-chipiona.access: Easy to reach from Chipiona, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-regla-chipiona.parking: Paid parking near the seafront; free spaces further back.
playa-de-regla-chipiona.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds, showers and lifeguards in season.
playa-de-regla-chipiona.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-regla-chipiona.note: Walk to the lighthouse and try the sweet muscatel wine that the town is known for.

playa-paraiso-villajoyosa.access: Beach reached by tram line 1 or by car.
playa-paraiso-villajoyosa.parking: Large car park, but reviewers report police ticketing and a stony access road
playa-paraiso-villajoyosa.food: Two beach bars open in summer.
playa-paraiso-villajoyosa.note: Lifeguards, showers, toilets and disabled access. Campervans and pets are not allowed.

praia-grande-ferragudo.access: Easy to reach from Ferragudo, on foot or by short drive.
praia-grande-ferragudo.parking: Free parking near the beach; fills in August.
praia-grande-ferragudo.sunbeds: Beach bars, restaurants, sunbeds, showers and lifeguards in season.
praia-grande-ferragudo.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-grande-ferragudo.note: Visit the old fishing village and the fish restaurants by the river after your swim.

praia-da-barra-aveiro.access: Easy to reach from Aveiro, on foot or by short drive.
praia-da-barra-aveiro.parking: Large free car park near the lighthouse.
praia-da-barra-aveiro.sunbeds: Beach bars, showers, surf schools and lifeguards in season.
praia-da-barra-aveiro.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-da-barra-aveiro.note: Visit the lighthouse and then take the town boats through the canals of Aveiro.

vila-nova-de-milfontes-beach.access: Sheltered river side and rougher Atlantic side; currents near the river bar.
vila-nova-de-milfontes-beach.food: A Choupana restaurant on the beach, busy at lunch.
vila-nova-de-milfontes-beach.note: Rescuers and first aid listed; confirm lifeguard hours.

praia-dos-olhos-de-agua.parking: Paid parking at the entrance with limited spaces; street parking nearby
praia-dos-olhos-de-agua.food: Seafront restaurants such as La Cigale.
praia-dos-olhos-de-agua.note: Blue Flag listed and lifeguards in season. Crowded from July to mid-September.

plage-de-trestraou-perros-guirec.access: Easy to reach from Perros-Guirec, on foot or by short drive.
plage-de-trestraou-perros-guirec.parking: Paid parking along the seafront; free spaces further back.
plage-de-trestraou-perros-guirec.sunbeds: Beach clubs, sunbeds, sailing school, cafes, showers and lifeguards in season.
plage-de-trestraou-perros-guirec.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-trestraou-perros-guirec.note: Walk the coastal path to Ploumanach for the pink granite boulders, and check the tide times.

plage-du-trez-benodet.access: Easy to reach from Benodet, on foot or by short drive.
plage-du-trez-benodet.parking: Free parking along the seafront; larger paid lots in town.
plage-du-trez-benodet.sunbeds: Beach cafes, sailing school, showers and lifeguards in season.
plage-du-trez-benodet.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-du-trez-benodet.note: Take a boat trip to the Glenan islands and walk the coast path to the lighthouse.

plage-de-mimizan.access: Easy to reach from Mimizan, on foot or by short drive.
plage-de-mimizan.parking: Large paid car parks behind the dunes; cycle path from town.
plage-de-mimizan.sunbeds: Beach bars, surf schools, showers and lifeguards in season.
plage-de-mimizan.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-mimizan.note: Swim only between the flags where the lifeguards are, and cycle through the forest at the end of the day.

plage-du-kelenn-carantec.access: Easy to reach from Carantec, on foot or by short drive.
plage-du-kelenn-carantec.parking: Paid parking near the beach; free spaces further back.
plage-du-kelenn-carantec.sunbeds: Sailing club, sunbeds, cafes and showers in season.
plage-du-kelenn-carantec.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-du-kelenn-carantec.note: Walk across the sands to the island of Callot at low tide, and check the tide times before you leave.

elafonisi-beach-crete.access: By car from Chania (1.5 to 2 hours, narrow for the last 15 km), by seasonal bus or on an organised tour; from the car park it is about a 10 minute walk to the sand.
elafonisi-beach-crete.parking: Several paid lots along the road; most guides recommend the last, closest lot (about EUR 5 a day). Lots fill by 9am in July and August.
elafonisi-beach-crete.sunbeds: Paid sunbeds and umbrellas in season (one visitor reported about EUR 20 for two beds and an umbrella); they sell out by mid-morning, so bring your own umbrella.
elafonisi-beach-crete.food: Snack bar and small cafes by the parking area, with queues at lunchtime. Bring water and snacks.
elafonisi-beach-crete.note: Arrive before 9am in July and August. Some snack bars and sunbed stands are not open yet in May.

kokkari-beach-samos.access: Easy to reach from Kokkari, on foot or by short drive.
kokkari-beach-samos.parking: Free parking on the village streets; limited in August.
kokkari-beach-samos.sunbeds: Sunbeds, tavernas, windsurf school and showers in season.
kokkari-beach-samos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
kokkari-beach-samos.note: Swim in the morning before the wind rises, and eat grilled fish at a harbour taverna.

vatera-beach-lesbos.access: Easy to reach from Vatera, on foot or by short drive.
vatera-beach-lesbos.parking: Free parking along the beach road.
vatera-beach-lesbos.sunbeds: Sunbeds, tavernas and beach bars at the village end, showers in season.
vatera-beach-lesbos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
vatera-beach-lesbos.note: Walk away from the village end to find empty stretches, and visit the nearby thermal springs at Polichnitos.

spiaggia-di-vendicari.access: Four entrances to the reserve (Main, Calamosche, Eloro, Cittadella). Calamosche is about a 20 minute walk from the parking.
spiaggia-di-vendicari.parking: Paid parking at the entrances, about EUR 3-5 reported
spiaggia-di-vendicari.food: No food on the beaches; snacks at nearby agriturismi and restaurants in Noto.
spiaggia-di-vendicari.note: Reserve entry fee reported at about EUR 3-7 depending on the source. No showers on the beaches. Confirm current prices.

zlatni-rt-rovinj.access: Walk, cycle or take the forest park promenade; the park is a car-limited nature area.
zlatni-rt-rovinj.parking: Sources disagree: spaces in front of the park, or paid around EUR 7 per day with a 10-15 minute walk
zlatni-rt-rovinj.sunbeds: Beach bars rent loungers and parasols.
zlatni-rt-rovinj.food: Several beach bars in the park.
zlatni-rt-rovinj.note: Rocky platforms and pebbles in a pine and cypress forest park. No sand.

cikat-bay-losinj.access: Several inlets, some sandy; reached on foot from Mali Losinj or by hotel buses.
cikat-bay-losinj.parking: Parking directly on the beach (camping side) and near the hotels
cikat-bay-losinj.sunbeds: Sunbeds, umbrellas, paddleboards, kayaks and pedal boats for rent.
cikat-bay-losinj.food: Several bars and restaurants; one listing disagrees.
cikat-bay-losinj.note: Showers and changing rooms. Mostly pebbles.

ambrela-beach-verudela.access: Easy to reach from Verudela, on foot or by short drive.
ambrela-beach-verudela.parking: Paid parking at the resort; buses run from Pula.
ambrela-beach-verudela.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds, water sports, showers and a promenade in season.
ambrela-beach-verudela.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
ambrela-beach-verudela.note: Walk the coastal path to find quieter coves and take the bus from Pula to avoid parking.

playa-de-la-olla-altea.access: Easy to reach from Altea, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-la-olla-altea.parking: Paid parking in town and along the promenade; fills in August.
playa-de-la-olla-altea.sunbeds: Beach bars, restaurants, showers and a promenade; sunbeds in season.
playa-de-la-olla-altea.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-la-olla-altea.note: Climb to the old town for views over the bay, and swim early before the promenade fills up.

playa-de-la-zurriola-san-sebastian.parking: Parking listed; no details on cost or capacity
playa-de-la-zurriola-san-sebastian.food: Cafes and bars near the beach.
playa-de-la-zurriola-san-sebastian.note: Lifeguards June 1 to September 30 (10:00-20:00). 24 hot showers and 536 lockers. Local surf club and four surf schools.

playa-de-bakio.access: Easy to reach from Bakio, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-bakio.parking: Paid parking near the beach; free spaces on the hillside.
playa-de-bakio.sunbeds: Surf schools, bars, showers and lifeguards in season.
playa-de-bakio.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-bakio.note: Combine a swim with the walk to San Juan de Gaztelugatxe, and swim only where the lifeguards are on duty.

praia-de-sesimbra.access: Easy to reach from Sesimbra, on foot or by short drive.
praia-de-sesimbra.parking: Paid parking near the seafront; free spaces higher in the town.
praia-de-sesimbra.sunbeds: Sunbeds, showers, cafes, restaurants and lifeguards in season.
praia-de-sesimbra.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-de-sesimbra.note: Eat grilled fish at the harbour and visit the castle for views over the bay.

praia-de-cacela-velha.access: About 45 minutes east of Faro and 15 minutes from Tavira. The beach is across the lagoon from the village: walk at low tide or take a boat from Fabrica.
praia-de-cacela-velha.parking: Parking near the village (reported free); parking at Fabrica for the boat is increasingly difficult.
praia-de-cacela-velha.food: Restaurants in the village; names and hours not confirmed.
praia-de-cacela-velha.note: Check tide times first. Bus 67 runs between Faro and Vila Real de Santo Antonio, with a walk of about 15 minutes from the stop.

portinho-da-arrabida.access: From 1 June to 15 September private cars are not allowed on the road to Portinho from about 7am to 7pm (residents, taxis, scooters and public transport excepted). Free summer shuttles and buses run from Setubal; check the current Arrabida sem Carros rules.
portinho-da-arrabida.parking: Parking is paid in the bathing season and very limited; the car ban exists because the roads are dead ends with few spaces.
portinho-da-arrabida.food: Restaurante Farol stands where the port area ends and the beach begins; it is one of the few places to eat in the park.
portinho-da-arrabida.note: Plan to arrive by shuttle, bus, bike or on foot in summer, and confirm the current hours of the traffic ban with Setubal council.

praia-grande-porto-covo.access: Easy to reach from Porto Covo, on foot or by short drive.
praia-grande-porto-covo.parking: Free parking in the village; fills in August.
praia-grande-porto-covo.sunbeds: Beach bars, restaurants, showers and lifeguards in season.
praia-grande-porto-covo.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-grande-porto-covo.note: Walk the Fishermen Trail to nearby coves and swim only where the lifeguards are on duty.

plage-de-nice-baie-des-anges.access: Easy to reach from Nice, on foot or by short drive.
plage-de-nice-baie-des-anges.parking: Paid underground car parks in the centre; tram and buses run along the coast.
plage-de-nice-baie-des-anges.sunbeds: Beach clubs with sunbeds, free public sections, showers and cafes.
plage-de-nice-baie-des-anges.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-nice-baie-des-anges.note: Wear sandals for the pebbles, use the free public sections for a cheaper day, and walk to the old town for socca.

plage-de-la-grande-mer-cassis.access: Central family beach with sand, pebbles and gravel.
plage-de-la-grande-mer-cassis.parking: Mimosas car park about five minutes walk away; parking near the beach can be expensive
plage-de-la-grande-mer-cassis.sunbeds: Le Grand Large runs a private sunbed section in summer.
plage-de-la-grande-mer-cassis.food: Restaurants, bars and snack bars on the quays.
plage-de-la-grande-mer-cassis.note: Showers, toilets, lifeguard post and pedalo, kayak and windsurf rentals. Lifeguards mid-June to mid-September.

plage-notre-dame-porquerolles.access: Ferry from La Tour Fondue (Giens) in about 20 minutes, every 30 to 45 minutes in summer; a few crossings leave from Hyeres. There are no cars on Porquerolles, so rent a bike at the port or walk.
plage-notre-dame-porquerolles.parking: No cars on the island. On the mainland the Tour Fondue car park fills in July and August and is capped at about EUR 21 a day; a free car park near Hyeres port has a summer shuttle to the ferry.
plage-notre-dame-porquerolles.food: No shops at the beach, so buy supplies before you cross. Cafes and restaurants are in the village by the port, and the nearby Plage d Argent has a restaurant.
plage-notre-dame-porquerolles.note: The most popular and busiest beach on the island: avoid mid to late July and August, and take an early ferry.

plage-de-cannes-la-croisette.access: Easy to reach from Cannes, on foot or by short drive.
plage-de-cannes-la-croisette.parking: Paid underground car parks nearby; trains stop at Cannes station.
plage-de-cannes-la-croisette.sunbeds: Beach clubs with sunbeds, public sections, showers and restaurants.
plage-de-cannes-la-croisette.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-cannes-la-croisette.note: Use the free public beach at Plage du Midi for a cheaper day, and take a boat to the Lerins islands.

almanarre-beach-hyeres.access: Easy to reach from Almanarre, on foot or by short drive.
almanarre-beach-hyeres.parking: Large paid car parks behind the beach; fills in summer.
almanarre-beach-hyeres.sunbeds: Windsurf and kitesurf schools, beach bars, showers and lifeguards in season.
almanarre-beach-hyeres.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
almanarre-beach-hyeres.note: Watch the kitesurfers from the beach, and visit the salt pans of Les Salins at sunset.

xerokampos-beach-crete.access: Steep, narrow descent; not for large or low-clearance vehicles.
xerokampos-beach-crete.parking: Small free parking area near the beach
xerokampos-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sources disagree: a few sunbeds may be rented at Mazida Ammos; another guide says none.
xerokampos-beach-crete.food: Traditional tavernas in the nearby Ampelos settlement.
xerokampos-beach-crete.note: No shade at Mazida Ammos. The Meltemi can blow in July and August afternoons; mornings are calmer.

spiaggia-di-notteri-villasimius.access: A few minutes from Villasimius on the Capo Carbonara peninsula; a eucalyptus-shaded path leads from the car park to the sand.
spiaggia-di-notteri-villasimius.parking: Large car park near the beach; one visitor reported about EUR 10.
spiaggia-di-notteri-villasimius.sunbeds: Beach services with sunbed and umbrella rental in season.
spiaggia-di-notteri-villasimius.food: Kiosks, bars and restaurants near the sea.
spiaggia-di-notteri-villasimius.note: The shallow Notteri lagoon behind the beach is a habitat for pink flamingos.

cala-azzurra-favignana.access: About 5 km from the Favignana ferry terminal, 15 to 20 minutes by bike; ferries from Trapani take about 30 minutes and fill up at weekends.
cala-azzurra-favignana.parking: Small parking area, but most visitors cycle; bike hire is about EUR 5 a day at shops away from the ferry touts.
cala-azzurra-favignana.sunbeds: No sunbed hire confirmed; the beach is mostly rock with a natural seaweed cushion. Lido Burrone nearby has umbrellas.
cala-azzurra-favignana.food: Food trucks and a small bar with cold drinks and snacks nearby; no restaurant.
cala-azzurra-favignana.note: Rocks are sharp in places, so wear sea shoes. The beach fills after 11am.

platja-de-llafranc.access: Summer parking near the beach is not easy; blue-zone paid parking applies.
platja-de-llafranc.parking: Blue-zone paid parking; hard in summer
platja-de-llafranc.food: Several restaurants nearby including El Far, La Sirena and La Llagosta.
platja-de-llafranc.note: Hotel Llafranch is close to the beach and has a restaurant.

sjekirica-beach-brsecine.access: Boat from Dubrovnik, or steep goat paths from the highway, which is rarely done.
sjekirica-beach-brsecine.note: No facilities. The trail near Brsecine has been used as a toilet and dump, so take litter out.

spiaggia-di-capo-coda-cavallo.access: About 20 minutes from San Teodoro and 35 from Olbia by car.
spiaggia-di-capo-coda-cavallo.parking: Car park fills quickly in summer
spiaggia-di-capo-coda-cavallo.sunbeds: Umbrellas, loungers and boats for rent; Lido Kayak in the Punta Est area.
spiaggia-di-capo-coda-cavallo.food: Refreshment stands and a sea-view bar at Lido Kayak.
spiaggia-di-capo-coda-cavallo.note: Campsite and accessible facilities nearby. Sources do not clearly separate the neighbouring beaches.

agiofarago-beach-crete.access: Parking is about 6 km beyond Kaloi Limenes on a gravel road, then a walk of 30-45 minutes down the gorge. Boat access from Matala and Agia Galini.
agiofarago-beach-crete.parking: Gravel lot about 6 km past Kaloi Limenes
agiofarago-beach-crete.food: A canteen by the car park; nothing at the beach, so bring water and snacks.
agiofarago-beach-crete.note: Wear sturdy shoes. Wild goats climb on cars parked in shade. Naturism is discouraged because of the chapel in the gorge.

aliki-beach-thasos.access: Small bay on a peninsula beside the ancient marble quarry site.
aliki-beach-thasos.parking: Free street parking above the beach and spaces along the main road; arrive early
aliki-beach-thasos.sunbeds: Tavernas rent sunbeds: about EUR 20 for two and an umbrella, or a minimum spend (about EUR 30-70).
aliki-beach-thasos.food: Tavernas such as Leonidas; some offer free sunbeds to diners.
aliki-beach-thasos.note: Calm clear water, good for children. The archaeological site is next to the beach.

kommos-beach-crete.access: The road ends at a car park beside the Minoan site and the beach.
kommos-beach-crete.parking: Free car park at the end of the road
kommos-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sources conflict: municipal loungers about EUR 2 each at the southern end, or none because of turtle conservation.
kommos-beach-crete.food: Two tavernas near the southern cliffs and a food truck reported.
kommos-beach-crete.note: Loggerhead turtle nesting beach with seasonal restrictions. Windy in summer. The Minoan site cannot be entered. The northern part is naturist.

laganas-beach-zakynthos.access: Easy to reach from Laganas, on foot or by short drive.
laganas-beach-zakynthos.parking: Roadside parking along the main road and small car parks near the resort strip.
laganas-beach-zakynthos.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, water sports, tavernas and showers on the main sections.
laganas-beach-zakynthos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
laganas-beach-zakynthos.note: Respect the marked turtle nesting areas, keep off roped-off sand, and walk east for quieter stretches.

tonnara-di-scopello.access: By car to Scopello near Castellammare del Golfo; entry to the beach is through the Tonnara site.
tonnara-di-scopello.parking: Paid lots near the entrance, reported at EUR 7 to 15 a day (more in July).
tonnara-di-scopello.sunbeds: Sunbeds for hire at extra cost.
tonnara-di-scopello.food: Small cafe with snacks and drinks.
tonnara-di-scopello.note: Entry is ticketed (recent visitors reported EUR 15 to 25; buying online helps in high season), so check the official site.

spiaggia-di-capriccioli.access: About 30 km from Olbia via the SS125, SP73 and SP94; there is no regular bus, so use a car or scooter.
spiaggia-di-capriccioli.parking: Small paid lot, reported at EUR 8 to 20 a day; it fills by 9:30am in July and August. Access to the beach is free.
spiaggia-di-capriccioli.food: One visitor mentions a beach bar but this is unverified; bring water.
spiaggia-di-capriccioli.note: Four small coves with turquoise water; arrive early.

baia-verde-gallipoli.access: Easy to reach from Baia Verde, on foot or by short drive.
baia-verde-gallipoli.parking: Paid and free parking along the roads behind the beach; fills in August.
baia-verde-gallipoli.sunbeds: Beach clubs with sunbeds, bars, restaurants and showers; free sections between them.
baia-verde-gallipoli.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
baia-verde-gallipoli.note: Choose a free section away from the busiest clubs, and walk back to the old town for dinner.

cala-liberotto-orosei.access: Easy beach on the Gulf of Orosei.
cala-liberotto-orosei.parking: Free parking reported close to the beach; rentals note free parking is uncommon
cala-liberotto-orosei.sunbeds: Sunbeds and towels rentable on request (one source).
cala-liberotto-orosei.food: Seaside kiosks with ice cream and lunch; two bars reported.
cala-liberotto-orosei.note: Sandy beaches in the gulf are rarely overcrowded. Details come mainly from rental listings.

lokrum-island-dubrovnik.access: Ferry from the Old Port (Luza pier) every 15-30 minutes in high season; about EUR 30 adult return including reserve entry (2026 guide).
lokrum-island-dubrovnik.parking: No cars; ferry from the Old Port
lokrum-island-dubrovnik.sunbeds: None; swim from rocks and piers.
lokrum-island-dubrovnik.food: Cafes and restaurants on the island, pricey; you can bring your own food.
lokrum-island-dubrovnik.note: No sandy beach. Swimming from rocks, the two east piers and a small saltwater lake in the south.

palmizana-beach-pakleni-islands.access: Taxi boats from Hvar Town, about 15-30 minutes; roughly EUR 10 each way (reported).
palmizana-beach-pakleni-islands.parking: No cars; taxi boat from Hvar Town
palmizana-beach-pakleni-islands.sunbeds: Loungers on a narrow shore; about EUR 25 reported.
palmizana-beach-pakleni-islands.food: Restaurants and bars in the settlement including Meneghello.
palmizana-beach-pakleni-islands.note: Fine gravel and sand beside a pine wood; part is naturist. Busy with boats.

valun-beach-cres.access: Easy to reach from Valun, on foot or by short drive.
valun-beach-cres.parking: Small paid car park above the village; limited in summer.
valun-beach-cres.sunbeds: A few konobas and cafes, a small harbour and some rooms; no beach clubs.
valun-beach-cres.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
valun-beach-cres.note: Walk the old path up to the hilltop village of Lubenice for views, and eat fish at a harbour konoba.

trstevica-beach-prvic.access: Easy to reach from Sepurine, on foot or by short drive.
trstevica-beach-prvic.parking: No cars on the island; take the ferry or a taxi boat from Vodice and walk.
trstevica-beach-prvic.sunbeds: A beach bar and a few tavernas in the village; limited facilities on the beach.
trstevica-beach-prvic.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
trstevica-beach-prvic.note: Check the ferry times before you go, and bring water shoes for the pebbles.

playa-de-riazor-a-coruna.access: Easy to reach from A Coruna, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-riazor-a-coruna.parking: Paid street parking and underground car parks nearby; city buses stop close to the beach.
playa-de-riazor-a-coruna.sunbeds: Lifeguards, showers, a promenade, cafes and a surf school nearby.
playa-de-riazor-a-coruna.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-riazor-a-coruna.note: Swim between the lifeguard flags, and walk the seafront promenade towards the Tower of Hercules at sunset.

playa-de-los-muertos-carboneras.access: No road to the beach: a steep 10 to 15 minute footpath of loose gravel leads down from the clifftop car park on the AL-5106. Wear closed shoes.
playa-de-los-muertos-carboneras.parking: Clifftop lot at about EUR 4 to 5 a day in high season and free in low season; it fills early in summer.
playa-de-los-muertos-carboneras.sunbeds: None reported: no shade or showers on the sand.
playa-de-los-muertos-carboneras.food: No bars on the sand; a drinks stall at the car park, and one guide recommends Chiringuito J. Mariano (location unconfirmed).
playa-de-los-muertos-carboneras.note: Bring water, shade and energy for the climb back up.

playa-de-oyambre.access: Walk from the beach access; reached by car via the CA-131.
playa-de-oyambre.parking: Fewer than 50 spaces at the beach access; roadside spots
playa-de-oyambre.food: Food and drink vendors; the Kampaoh campsite has a snack bar.
playa-de-oyambre.note: Toilets, showers, foot rinse and lifeguards. Inside Oyambre Natural Park; protected dunes. Intermediate surf break.

playa-de-arrietara-sopelana.access: Easy on foot or by car.
playa-de-arrietara-sopelana.parking: Supervised car park with more than 100 spaces
playa-de-arrietara-sopelana.food: Bar-chiringuito and a restaurant with a terrace and views.
playa-de-arrietara-sopelana.note: Surf centre of the area, with about six clubs and three schools. Public toilets.

praia-do-monte-clerigo.access: In the village of Monte Clerigo near Aljezur, with the beach just below.
praia-do-monte-clerigo.parking: Street parking near the entrance; it can be crowded in summer.
praia-do-monte-clerigo.food: Restaurants and a beach cafe in the village; toilets reported.
praia-do-monte-clerigo.note: A popular surf beach with a surf school in season. Lifeguard cover varies, so check on arrival.

praia-da-manta-rota.access: Easy, flat beach near the village.
praia-da-manta-rota.parking: Large free car park shaded by trees; paid parking at the Oeste section
praia-da-manta-rota.food: Bars and restaurants on the sand and in the village.
praia-da-manta-rota.note: Lifeguards in the bathing season until about 7 pm; showers and toilets.

praia-do-algodio-ericeira.access: Easy to reach from Ericeira, on foot or by short drive.
praia-do-algodio-ericeira.parking: Street parking in Ericeira; limited in summer.
praia-do-algodio-ericeira.sunbeds: Lifeguards, a beach bar and showers in season.
praia-do-algodio-ericeira.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-do-algodio-ericeira.note: Check the surf and tide before swimming, and walk the cliff path to nearby beaches.

praia-do-tamariz-estoril.access: Easy to reach from Estoril, on foot or by short drive.
praia-do-tamariz-estoril.parking: Paid parking near the seafront; the Cascais line train from Lisbon stops at Estoril.
praia-do-tamariz-estoril.sunbeds: Lifeguards, showers, sunbeds, beach bars, restaurants and a promenade.
praia-do-tamariz-estoril.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-do-tamariz-estoril.note: Take the train from Cais do Sodre, and walk the promenade to Cascais at sunset.

plage-de-morgat-crozon.access: Wide family beach more than 1 km long, from the marina to Rulianec.
plage-de-morgat-crozon.parking: Street parking; a paid motorhome area 15 minutes on foot
plage-de-morgat-crozon.food: Creperies and a hotel restaurant and bar a short walk away.
plage-de-morgat-crozon.note: Summer kids club on the central part. Calm swimming.

plage-saint-francoise-ajaccio.access: Easy to reach from Ajaccio, on foot or by short drive.
plage-saint-francoise-ajaccio.parking: Paid car parks nearby; the town centre is a short walk.
plage-saint-francoise-ajaccio.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds and showers in season; lifeguards in summer.
plage-saint-francoise-ajaccio.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-saint-francoise-ajaccio.note: Walk to the old town for lunch, and swim in the morning before the town beaches fill up.

espiguette-beach-le-grau-du-roi.access: Long open beach reached from two car parks at opposite ends.
espiguette-beach-le-grau-du-roi.parking: Paid car park, about EUR 6 reported, filling quickly on busy days
espiguette-beach-le-grau-du-roi.food: No permanent beach restaurant; occasional vendors.
espiguette-beach-le-grau-du-roi.note: A naturist area lies in the eastern part. Lifeguard coverage not confirmed. Quieter the further you walk from the car park.

plage-de-coz-pors-tregastel.access: Two spacious car parks east of town; avoid parking in town. July and August are busy.
plage-de-coz-pors-tregastel.parking: Two large car parks east of town
plage-de-coz-pors-tregastel.food: A restaurant at the beach (listed by the tourist office).
plage-de-coz-pors-tregastel.note: Supervised in July and August. The GR34 coastal path runs along it, and islets are reachable at low tide.

plage-du-verger-cancale.access: Easy to reach from Cancale, on foot or by short drive.
plage-du-verger-cancale.parking: Free and paid car parks near the beach.
plage-du-verger-cancale.sunbeds: Lifeguards in summer, a seasonal cafe and showers; no sunbeds.
plage-du-verger-cancale.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-du-verger-cancale.note: Check the tide times before you swim, and eat Cancale oysters at the harbour in town.

tucepi-beach.access: About 4 km of pebbles backed by pines; a promenade runs above the beach.
tucepi-beach.parking: Reports disagree: about EUR 10 a day, or EUR 20-25 for lots outside town
tucepi-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds and parasols for rent; about EUR 30 for two (reported).
tucepi-beach.food: Restaurants and shops on the promenade; a beach bar.
tucepi-beach.note: The longest beach on the Makarska Riviera; pine shade. Busy in summer.

njivice-beach-krk.access: Easy to reach from Njivice, on foot or by short drive.
njivice-beach-krk.parking: Paid parking near the centre and along the promenade.
njivice-beach-krk.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, cafes, showers and water sports in season.
njivice-beach-krk.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
njivice-beach-krk.note: Swim early to find space in July and August, and wear water shoes for the pebbles.

donje-celo-beach-kolocep.access: Ferry from Dubrovnik; no cars on the island.
donje-celo-beach-kolocep.food: Two restaurants on the island and a small shop with limited hours.
donje-celo-beach-kolocep.note: Sand beach beside the ferry port. Very busy in high season. Ferry times are hard to find, so check ahead.

argeles-plage.access: Easy to reach from Argeles-sur-Mer, on foot or by short drive.
argeles-plage.parking: Paid and free car parks behind the beach; busy in August.
argeles-plage.sunbeds: Lifeguards in summer, sunbeds, cafes, showers and water sports.
argeles-plage.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
argeles-plage.note: Walk or cycle along the beach towards a quieter stretch, and swim between the lifeguard flags.

plage-de-cabasson.access: Paid parking at Parc Capalo in Cabasson, roughly April-November. Brégançon fort beach is reached on foot from here.
plage-de-cabasson.parking: Paid CaPaLo car park, about EUR 11-13
plage-de-cabasson.food: Restaurant, toilets, showers and picnic tables.
plage-de-cabasson.note: Car prices differ between listings; check before you go.

plage-du-dossen.access: Beach car park on Rue de Sieck in Santec; follow the Dossen signs.
plage-du-dossen.parking: Car park on Rue de Sieck, Santec
plage-du-dossen.food: Beach Break creperie, bar and shop facing the sea; surf school at the car park.
plage-du-dossen.note: Dunes and a state forest border the beach. A versatile surf spot.

baie-des-trepasses.access: Dedicated car parks on the access roads; very busy in season.
baie-des-trepasses.parking: Dedicated car parks; very busy in season
baie-des-trepasses.note: Supervised in summer (13:30-19:00 by SNSM, reported); swimming outside supervised hours is prohibited. Strong surf.

nonza-beach.access: On foot from Nonza village: about 15 minutes down a rocky staircase or steep path, and back up.
nonza-beach.parking: Very few paid spaces in the village (pay by card at the machine); one visitor mentions another car park about 2 km further on with an easier walk.
nonza-beach.food: La Sassa restaurant below the tower in the village; busy at lunchtime.
nonza-beach.note: Black pebble beach, so water shoes help. Come early or late to avoid the lunchtime crowd in the village.

ostriconi-beach.access: About 15 km from L Ile-Rousse on the edge of the Agriates desert; reached on foot only, by a path from the former main road.
ostriconi-beach.parking: Not confirmed; a campsite stands about 1 km (11 minutes on foot) from the beach.
ostriconi-beach.food: No restaurant mentioned in the sources, so bring food and water.
ostriconi-beach.note: Supervised in summer. Waves can be dangerous in high winds, and the Agriates coastal path starts at the far end.

plage-du-canadel.access: Easy to reach on foot from the main road.
plage-du-canadel.parking: Signposted car park on the D559 near the chapel; parking is not easy
plage-du-canadel.sunbeds: Paillotes on the left rent mattresses.
plage-du-canadel.food: Paillotes and L Ancre d Or restaurant (open mid-April to mid-September).
plage-du-canadel.note: Free access beach; no dogs 08:00-19:00 from June to September on public stretches.

xi-beach-kefalonia.access: Reached by road; buses run from Lixouri; no boardwalk, so hard for wheelchairs.
xi-beach-kefalonia.parking: Free public parking behind the beach; taverna lots
xi-beach-kefalonia.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent at beach clubs.
xi-beach-kefalonia.food: Tavernas and bars along the beach.
xi-beach-kefalonia.note: Blue Flag. Red sand and clay cliffs; do not take clay away in bulk. Clay can stain light swimwear.

roukounas-beach-anafi.access: Short walk from the bus stop or about 3 km from Chora.
roukounas-beach-anafi.food: Taverna behind the beach, about 50 m from the sea; a second taverna reported.
roukounas-beach-anafi.note: Natural shade from tamarisk trees, hard to get in high season. Toilets and showers reported. Bring an umbrella.

skala-potamia-beach-thasos.access: Easy to reach from Skala Potamia, on foot or by short drive.
skala-potamia-beach-thasos.parking: Free parking along the seafront road.
skala-potamia-beach-thasos.sunbeds: Tavernas, sunbeds, parasols and showers along the seafront.
skala-potamia-beach-thasos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
skala-potamia-beach-thasos.note: Eat fresh fish at a harbour taverna in the evening, and swim early for the quietest water.

tolo-beach-peloponnese.access: Easy to reach from Tolo, on foot or by short drive.
tolo-beach-peloponnese.parking: Free and paid parking along the seafront; limited in August.
tolo-beach-peloponnese.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, tavernas, bars and water sports along the beach.
tolo-beach-peloponnese.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
tolo-beach-peloponnese.note: Combine a swim with a day trip to the old town of Nafplio or the ancient theatre of Epidaurus.

citara-beach-ischia.access: Easy to reach from Citara, on foot or by short drive.
citara-beach-ischia.parking: Paid parking and local buses from Forio.
citara-beach-ischia.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, bars, showers and a thermal park nearby.
citara-beach-ischia.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
citara-beach-ischia.note: Stay for the sunset, and check the wind, as the west coast can be breezy.

porto-ferro-beach.access: Short walk from the car park; dunes and pines separate the beach from Lake Baratz.
porto-ferro-beach.parking: Free unpaved lot by the beach entrance
porto-ferro-beach.food: A bar and grill at the start of the beach (check season hours); kiosks.
porto-ferro-beach.note: Dogs welcome. The north end near the White Tower is used by naturists. Watch for strong currents on the south side.

baia-del-buondormire-palinuro.access: Boat only: shuttle boats from Palinuro port, or rent a pedal boat or canoe.
baia-del-buondormire-palinuro.parking: Paid parking at Palinuro port, about EUR 1 per hour (reported).
baia-del-buondormire-palinuro.note: Local reports say landing on the shore has been banned since 2020 because of falling rocks. Check locally before going; many visitors swim from the boat.

playa-de-benijo-tenerife.access: Steep footpath and stone steps from the road near Restaurante El Mirador; slippery after rain, not for reduced mobility. One site reports the path is officially closed since a July 2024 landslide order; check before you go.
playa-de-benijo-tenerife.parking: Limited; arrive early or park along the winding roadside
playa-de-benijo-tenerife.sunbeds: None; no rentals, kiosks or showers.
playa-de-benijo-tenerife.food: The mirador restaurant near the access point.
playa-de-benijo-tenerife.note: Strong waves and north-coast swell make swimming unsuitable much of the year; stay waist deep at most.

playazo-de-rodalquilar.access: Dirt road (ALP-826) passable by any car; short walk to the sand from the car park.
playazo-de-rodalquilar.parking: Free car parks at the entrance and near the campsite (50-100 spaces); fills early in high season
playazo-de-rodalquilar.food: No shops or bars; bring everything.
playazo-de-rodalquilar.note: Litter bins and cleaning service. Inside the Cabo de Gata natural park; sources disagree on the walk length.

playa-de-xago.access: Reached by short paths from nearby parking areas; one source gives a long walk.
playa-de-xago.parking: Parking areas nearby; details not confirmed
playa-de-xago.note: Lifeguard service and a picnic area. A long exposed beach with surf, about 20 minutes west of Gijon.

praia-do-rostro-fisterra.access: Small car park directly on the beach, about 5-6 km from Fisterra.
praia-do-rostro-fisterra.parking: Small lot for about 10 vehicles; busier in the evening
praia-do-rostro-fisterra.food: No bar confirmed at the beach.
praia-do-rostro-fisterra.note: No lifeguard or surf information found.

praia-da-amoreira-aljezur.access: Beach at the mouth of the Aljezur river in the Vicentine Coast Natural Park. At low tide you can wade across to the far side; not at high tide.
praia-da-amoreira-aljezur.parking: Car park and street parking; full by about 11:30 on summer days
praia-da-amoreira-aljezur.food: Restaurante Paraiso do Mar above the beach, with toilets (older guide); a small beach bar on the north side.
praia-da-amoreira-aljezur.note: Lifeguards in season (older guide). Currents near the river mouth can be strong at high tide.

praia-de-moledo.access: Easy to reach from Moledo, on foot or by short drive.
praia-de-moledo.parking: Free and paid parking near the beach, behind the pine wood.
praia-de-moledo.sunbeds: Lifeguards in summer, cafes, beach restaurants and showers.
praia-de-moledo.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-de-moledo.note: Walk along the sand towards the river mouth, and watch for cool water and strong waves.

praia-da-gale-albufeira.access: Easy to reach from Gale, on foot or by short drive.
praia-da-gale-albufeira.parking: Paid parking nearby; limited spaces in summer.
praia-da-gale-albufeira.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, restaurants, showers and lifeguards in season.
praia-da-gale-albufeira.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-da-gale-albufeira.note: Walk along the sand to the east or west for quieter stretches.

kolovare-beach-zadar.access: Easy to reach from Kolovare, on foot or by short drive.
kolovare-beach-zadar.parking: Paid parking near the Kolovare promenade; many visitors walk from the old town in about fifteen minutes.
kolovare-beach-zadar.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, beach bars, showers and water sports in season.
kolovare-beach-zadar.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
kolovare-beach-zadar.note: Walk here from the old town in the morning, and come back along the promenade for sunset over the islands.

raduca-beach-primosten.access: Easy to reach from Raduca, on foot or by short drive.
raduca-beach-primosten.parking: Parking along the coast road and in small car parks behind the beach.
raduca-beach-primosten.sunbeds: A few beach bars, sunbeds and parasols in season; otherwise quiet.
raduca-beach-primosten.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
raduca-beach-primosten.note: Come in the evening for the sunset, and wear water shoes on the pebbles.

bijeca-beach-medulin.access: Easy to reach from Bijeca, on foot or by short drive.
bijeca-beach-medulin.parking: Paid parking close to the beach and in Medulin; busy in July and August.
