bijeca-beach-medulin.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, cafes, showers and water sports in season.
bijeca-beach-medulin.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
bijeca-beach-medulin.note: Combine a swim with a day trip to the Kamenjak nature park near Premantura.

escalet-beach-ramatuelle.access: Short walk from the car park; the coastal path from Cap Camarat also leads here.
escalet-beach-ramatuelle.parking: Car park near the beach (about 10 spaces on the day lot); price not confirmed
escalet-beach-ramatuelle.food: Restaurant AMICI at Hotel L Escalet serves breakfast and lunch; catering nearby.
escalet-beach-ramatuelle.note: Toilets, showers and supervised bathing in season. Not wheelchair accessible.

arone-beach-piana.access: About 15-20 minutes by a narrow mountain road from Piana, then a stairway to the sea.
arone-beach-piana.parking: Partly shaded car park above the beach; spaces are hard to find in summer.
arone-beach-piana.food: Several restaurants and beach bars on the beach.
arone-beach-piana.note: Supervised in season, with a disabled access mat and an amphibious wheelchair (reported).

capo-di-feno-beach.access: Path from the car park; narrow winding road D111B, about 20 minutes from Ajaccio.
capo-di-feno-beach.parking: Free car and bike parking nearby
capo-di-feno-beach.food: A paillote with snacks and drinks.
capo-di-feno-beach.note: No showers or toilets. Lifeguard in July and August only (one source). Grand Capo and Petit Capo are two parts.

playa-de-ondarreta.access: Flat city beach, walk or bus from the centre.
playa-de-ondarreta.parking: No beach car park; a private garage about 12 minutes walk away
playa-de-ondarreta.food: Cafes and restaurants along the promenade.
playa-de-ondarreta.note: Toilets, changing rooms, showers (about EUR 1.60) and lifeguards. Facilities open 9:00-20:30 in July and August.

playa-d-en-bossa-ibiza.access: Easy to reach from Playa d en Bossa, on foot or by short drive.
playa-d-en-bossa-ibiza.parking: Paid parking along the seafront and nearby; buses run from Ibiza Town.
playa-d-en-bossa-ibiza.sunbeds: Beach clubs, sunbeds, parasols, bars, restaurants and water sports.
playa-d-en-bossa-ibiza.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-d-en-bossa-ibiza.note: Visit in the morning for the quietest sand, and walk to the south end for a calmer stretch.

baia-di-sistiana.access: Easy to reach from Sistiana, on foot or by short drive.
baia-di-sistiana.parking: Paid parking above the bay; a short walk or shuttle leads down to the water.
baia-di-sistiana.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, bars and showers at the main bathing areas in season.
baia-di-sistiana.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
baia-di-sistiana.note: Walk the Rilke path along the cliffs to Duino for sea views, and wear water shoes on the pebbles.

cala-bianca-marina-di-camerota.access: Boat from Marina di Camerota in summer; private boats cannot moor. On foot about 40 minutes from Camping Romano or 1.5 hours from Lentiscelle.
cala-bianca-marina-di-camerota.parking: Parking about 20 minutes walk from the beach on an unpaved road; paid harbour parking about EUR 1 per hour
cala-bianca-marina-di-camerota.food: Lido Nettuno nearby for casual dining; nothing on the beach.
cala-bianca-marina-di-camerota.note: Roads are rocky and potholed. Anchoring is prohibited and the coast guard patrols.

kalogria-beach.access: Easy to reach from Kalogria, on foot or by short drive.
kalogria-beach.parking: Free parking along the forest track and near the tavernas.
kalogria-beach.sunbeds: A few tavernas and a small beach bar in season; most of the beach is undeveloped.
kalogria-beach.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
kalogria-beach.note: Bring shade and water, and walk the dunes towards the wetlands for birdwatching.

praia-de-mira.access: Easy to reach from Mira, on foot or by short drive.
praia-de-mira.parking: Free and paid parking near the beach and the lagoon.
praia-de-mira.sunbeds: Lifeguards in summer, beach cafes, showers and a promenade.
praia-de-mira.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-de-mira.note: Visit the calm Barrinha lagoon with children, and swim only in the lifeguarded area.

praia-do-furadouro.access: Easy to reach from Furadouro, on foot or by short drive.
praia-do-furadouro.parking: Free parking along the promenade and in the village.
praia-do-furadouro.sunbeds: Lifeguards in summer, cafes, restaurants and a seafront promenade.
praia-do-furadouro.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-do-furadouro.note: Look at the traditional boats on the sand, and swim only where lifeguards are on duty.

pupnatska-luka-beach-korcula.access: Road from Pupnat down to the bay.
pupnatska-luka-beach-korcula.parking: Parking within about 100 m; EUR 7-10 a day reported.
pupnatska-luka-beach-korcula.food: Two bars: Konoba Kod Mate and the Dalmos beach restaurant.
pupnatska-luka-beach-korcula.note: Showers available. Crowded in July and August; some places take cash only.

suha-punta-beach-rab.access: Easy to reach from Suha Punta, on foot or by short drive.
suha-punta-beach-rab.parking: Paid parking near the resort area and along the access road.
suha-punta-beach-rab.sunbeds: Cafes, sunbeds, parasols and showers at the main bathing areas in season.
suha-punta-beach-rab.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
suha-punta-beach-rab.note: Follow the shore path to find a quieter cove, and wear water shoes on the rocks.

platja-de-sa-riera-begur.access: Cove about 7 minutes from Begur, reached on foot or by car.
platja-de-sa-riera-begur.parking: Free parking reported; arrive early in peak summer
platja-de-sa-riera-begur.food: Bar and nearby restaurants such as El Raco de Sa Riera.
platja-de-sa-riera-begur.note: Showers, WC and Red Cross assisted bathing. A parking space for reduced mobility.

agia-marina-beach-aegina.access: Easy to reach from Agia Marina, on foot or by short drive.
agia-marina-beach-aegina.parking: Parking along the seafront; buses run from Aegina town.
agia-marina-beach-aegina.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, tavernas, cafes and water sports in season.
agia-marina-beach-aegina.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
agia-marina-beach-aegina.note: Take a ferry from Piraeus and combine the swim with a visit to the Temple of Aphaia nearby.

livadi-beach-astypalaia.access: Easy to reach from Livadi, on foot or by short drive.
livadi-beach-astypalaia.parking: Parking near the beach; it is also a short walk from Chora.
livadi-beach-astypalaia.sunbeds: Tavernas, a few rooms and some sunbeds in season.
livadi-beach-astypalaia.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
livadi-beach-astypalaia.note: Walk up to Chora and its windmills in the evening, and bring water shoes for the pebbles.

copacabana-beach-dubrovnik.access: Easy to reach from Copacabana, on foot or by short drive.
copacabana-beach-dubrovnik.parking: Paid parking at the nearby hotels and along the road; a city bus runs from Dubrovnik old town.
copacabana-beach-dubrovnik.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, beach bars, restaurants, showers and water sports in season.
copacabana-beach-dubrovnik.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
copacabana-beach-dubrovnik.note: Go in the morning or late afternoon to avoid the heat, and wear water shoes for the pebbles.

playa-del-postiguet-alicante.access: Easy to reach from Postiguet, on foot or by short drive.
playa-del-postiguet-alicante.parking: Paid parking in the old town and nearby car parks; the beach is a short walk from the centre.
playa-del-postiguet-alicante.sunbeds: Lifeguards, sunbeds, parasols, showers, bars and restaurants in season.
playa-del-postiguet-alicante.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-del-postiguet-alicante.note: Walk up to the Santa Barbara castle for the view over the bay, and visit in the morning in July and August.

playa-de-el-sardinero-santander.access: Flat urban beaches beside Mesones Park.
playa-de-el-sardinero-santander.parking: Large parking area by the Segunda beach; nearby streets harder
playa-de-el-sardinero-santander.food: Restaurants such as Abra, La Cania and Maremondo near the beach.
playa-de-el-sardinero-santander.note: Toilets, showers, lifeguards in high season, play area and paddle courts.

biodola-beach-elba.access: Easy; the road is widened in places for parking.
biodola-beach-elba.parking: Roadside parking allowed if traffic is not blocked; arrive early
biodola-beach-elba.food: Several bars, restaurants and ice cream shops on the bay.
biodola-beach-elba.note: Facilities are among the best on Elba. Lifeguard service not confirmed.

pramousquier-beach.access: Steps from the back alley down to the beach; harder to find than neighbouring beaches.
pramousquier-beach.parking: Park in the back alley off the D559 after Hotel Beau Site
pramousquier-beach.note: Canoe and SUP rental. About 2 km from Canadel by the old railway greenway.

praia-da-vieira-marinha-grande.access: Easy to reach from Vieira de Leiria, on foot or by short drive.
praia-da-vieira-marinha-grande.parking: Free parking near the beach and in the village.
praia-da-vieira-marinha-grande.sunbeds: Lifeguards in summer, cafes, restaurants and a promenade.
praia-da-vieira-marinha-grande.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-da-vieira-marinha-grande.note: Walk through the pine forest behind the beach, and swim only where lifeguards are on duty.

psili-ammos-beach-serifos.access: Reachable by bus or a 30 minute walk from Chora; concrete steps to the sand.
psili-ammos-beach-serifos.parking: Parking inside the tavernas or along the street, then a short walk
psili-ammos-beach-serifos.sunbeds: Sources disagree: a beach bar with sunbeds in the middle, or none organised.
psili-ammos-beach-serifos.note: Tamarisk trees give shade; some wooden umbrellas installed by the community.

livadakia-beach-serifos.access: Easy to reach from Livadakia, on foot or by short drive.
livadakia-beach-serifos.parking: Parking near Livadi port; the beach is a short walk from the village.
livadakia-beach-serifos.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, a beach bar and tavernas in season.
livadakia-beach-serifos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
livadakia-beach-serifos.note: Walk from Livadi along the shore path, and visit in the evening when the light is soft.

pefkoulia-beach-lefkada.access: Beach reached on foot from the car park.
pefkoulia-beach-lefkada.parking: Free roadside parking about 50 m away; a small lot near the restaurant fills early
pefkoulia-beach-lefkada.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas about EUR 10 reported, limited numbers.
pefkoulia-beach-lefkada.food: A bar and restaurant on the beach.
pefkoulia-beach-lefkada.note: Water is steep near the shore and rough when windy. Bring your own umbrella for afternoon shade.

pollonia-beach-milos.access: Easy to reach from Pollonia, on foot or by short drive.
pollonia-beach-milos.parking: Parking along the seafront and near the harbour.
pollonia-beach-milos.sunbeds: Tavernas, cafes, some sunbeds and parasols in season.
pollonia-beach-milos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
pollonia-beach-milos.note: Eat fresh fish at a harbour taverna in the evening, and take the ferry across to Kimolos for a day trip.

fasolou-beach-sifnos.access: Easy to reach from Fasolou, on foot or by short drive.
fasolou-beach-sifnos.parking: Parking near Faros; a short footpath leads to the bay.
fasolou-beach-sifnos.sunbeds: A few sunbeds and a taverna nearby; limited facilities.
fasolou-beach-sifnos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
fasolou-beach-sifnos.note: Walk the coast path from Faros to nearby coves, and bring water and sun cream.

frangokastello-beach-crete.parking: Gravel lot next to the castle; reports of about EUR 2 or free
frangokastello-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrella about EUR 6-7 per set.
frangokastello-beach-crete.food: Four or five tavernas near the castle.
frangokastello-beach-crete.note: Shallow water; north winds can make it rough. Orthi Ammos lies 300 m east over dunes.

agia-roumeli-beach-crete.access: Easy to reach from Agia Roumeli, on foot or by short drive.
agia-roumeli-beach-crete.parking: No road access; ferries run from Sougia, Loutro and Chora Sfakion.
agia-roumeli-beach-crete.sunbeds: Tavernas, cafes, some sunbeds and umbrellas in season.
agia-roumeli-beach-crete.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
agia-roumeli-beach-crete.note: Check the ferry times before you swim, and bring water shoes for the hot pebbles.

los-canos-de-meca-beach.access: Signposted access points; reached on foot or by car from the A-2233.
los-canos-de-meca-beach.parking: Unpatrolled car parks with fewer than 50 spaces
los-canos-de-meca-beach.food: Chiringuitos nearby such as El Chiringuito de Juan and La Palapa (location relative to the beach not confirmed).
los-canos-de-meca-beach.note: Toilets, showers and sports hire listed. A bus runs from Barbate.

playa-de-zahora-barbate.access: Hard by car; leave the car on the road through Zahora or at Sajorami.
playa-de-zahora-barbate.food: Chiringuitos in the busiest north-east zone, such as Chiringuito de Juan.
playa-de-zahora-barbate.note: Summer toilets, showers, changing rooms and lifeguards in the northeast zone (one guide); other sources list few facilities.

playa-de-carnota.access: Long open beach with mountain views.
playa-de-carnota.parking: Parking at the beach (details not confirmed)
playa-de-carnota.food: Bar O Cuberto bar and grill near the beach.
playa-de-carnota.note: More than 7 km long, the longest in Galicia. Little shade; showers. Parts are naturist.

cala-en-porter-menorca.access: About 180-200 steps down from the village; a seasonal mini-train covers the descent.
cala-en-porter-menorca.parking: Dedicated car park behind the beach (about a 3 minute walk down); tight in summer
cala-en-porter-menorca.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols and pedal boats for hire.
cala-en-porter-menorca.food: Bar, restaurant and a shop at the beach; more eateries in the village.
cala-en-porter-menorca.note: Sheltered by cliffs, sandy and shallow so good for families. Lifeguard in summer.

porto-pollo-beach-palau.access: Easy; separate zones for kiting, windsurfing and swimming.
porto-pollo-beach-palau.parking: Large day car park, paid by day and free overnight
porto-pollo-beach-palau.food: Bars and restaurants such as Rupi s Beach Bar and Bar Tiki.
porto-pollo-beach-palau.note: RRD Kitesurf Centre runs lessons and rental. Reviewers say lessons and rentals are pricey.

pescoluse-beach-salento.access: Easy and flat; known as the Maldives of Salento.
pescoluse-beach-salento.sunbeds: Paid lido sections with umbrellas; free areas where you can rent sunbeds or bring your own umbrella.
pescoluse-beach-salento.food: Many beach bars and restaurants close by.
pescoluse-beach-salento.note: Cleanliness reviews are mixed, better in high season. Shade in public areas is limited.

cupabia-beach-corsica.access: Easy from the car park. A steep dirt path of about 25 minutes leads to a small cove reachable only on foot or by boat.
cupabia-beach-corsica.food: Paillote beach restaurant with menus from about EUR 20; bar and campsite in summer.
cupabia-beach-corsica.note: Wild beach about 8 km north of Porto-Pollo.

soline-beach-brela.access: Easy; next to the Bluesun Hotel Soline.
soline-beach-brela.parking: Not confirmed. One hotel guest paid EUR 9 per day off-site.
soline-beach-brela.sunbeds: Paid beach club at the hotel.
soline-beach-brela.note: Details are thin for the public beach; check on arrival.

gradac-beach-makarska-riviera.access: Several beaches along 16 km; Gornja Vala is the longest.
gradac-beach-makarska-riviera.parking: Parking free at some hotels; a reviewer got a ticket at Duba bay
gradac-beach-makarska-riviera.sunbeds: Free for guests at some hotels; water sports for a fee.
gradac-beach-makarska-riviera.food: Restaurants on the promenade and in hotels.
gradac-beach-makarska-riviera.note: Details for the main town beach are thin; check the Gradac tourist board.

omis-beach.access: Easy to reach from Omis, on foot or by short drive.
omis-beach.parking: Paid parking in town and near the river mouth.
omis-beach.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, cafes and water sports in season.
omis-beach.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
omis-beach.note: Take a boat or a canoe up the Cetina canyon, and wear water shoes on the pebbles.

praia-da-mareta-sagres.access: Easy; short walk from the car park to the sand below Sagres fortress.
praia-da-mareta-sagres.parking: Car park by the beach; reviews say spaces run short at peak hours
praia-da-mareta-sagres.food: Bars and restaurants nearby, such as Tonel Beach Bar and Mar a Vista.
praia-da-mareta-sagres.note: Reviewers miss public showers and changing rooms. Winter surf is possible; summer swimming is cooler than the south coast.

praia-de-sao-torpes-sines.access: Easy to reach from Sao Torpes, on foot or by short drive.
praia-de-sao-torpes-sines.parking: Free parking behind the dunes and in the village.
praia-de-sao-torpes-sines.sunbeds: Lifeguards in summer, beach bars and restaurants nearby.
praia-de-sao-torpes-sines.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-de-sao-torpes-sines.note: Use the calm side near the breakwater for children, and swim only in the lifeguarded area.

praia-do-magoito-sintra.access: Steep path down; a ramp is reported for reduced mobility.
praia-do-magoito-sintra.parking: Car park near the beach; details not confirmed
praia-do-magoito-sintra.food: Beach bar and restaurant on site; Esplanada Duna Mar nearby.
praia-do-magoito-sintra.note: Blue Flag in the 2020s listings (season about 30 May to 13 September). Lifeguards, showers and toilets reported in season.

plage-des-blancs-sablons-le-conquet.access: Short path of about 5 minutes from the car park; Le Conquet is 15 minutes on foot.
plage-des-blancs-sablons-le-conquet.parking: Free unpaved lot (about 10 spaces) and a larger gravel lot; mostly used by surfers
plage-des-blancs-sablons-le-conquet.food: No beach facilities; the campsite nearby has toilets and showers.
plage-des-blancs-sablons-le-conquet.note: Sloped parking, no services at the car park.

kerfissien-beach-cleder.access: Not confirmed; the beach is a short walk from the Kerfissien houses.
kerfissien-beach-cleder.note: No public facilities information found. The sandy Les Amiets beach is about 800 m away.

la-capte-beach-hyeres.access: Easy to reach from La Capte, on foot or by short drive.
la-capte-beach-hyeres.parking: Paid and free parking along the coast road; busy in July and August.
la-capte-beach-hyeres.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, beach restaurants, windsurf schools and showers in season.
la-capte-beach-hyeres.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
la-capte-beach-hyeres.note: Walk or cycle along the Giens peninsula road, and check the wind before you swim.

valtos-beach-parga.access: Easy from the road car park; or 15-20 minutes on foot over Castle Hill from Parga.
valtos-beach-parga.parking: Large free car park alongside half the beach
valtos-beach-parga.sunbeds: Beach clubs in the middle rent sunbeds; about EUR 15-25 per set (reported); free zones at the edges.
valtos-beach-parga.food: Bars and restaurants serve each beach sector; some clubs ask a minimum spend.
valtos-beach-parga.note: Water taxi from Parga runs every 30 minutes in season (EUR 3-6 reported). No bus to Parga.

agios-pavlos-beach-rethymno.access: Paved road from Sachtouria; dunes beside the village. Do not confuse it with the Sfakia Agios Pavlos (no road).
agios-pavlos-beach-rethymno.sunbeds: Partly organised with umbrellas and sunbeds; some tavernas rent loungers.
agios-pavlos-beach-rethymno.note: Large sand dunes. The neighbouring Akoumiani beach is reached by a path and is often wavy.

marathias-beach-zakynthos.access: Short dirt road; beach is small and pebbly.
marathias-beach-zakynthos.food: Two tavernas sit above the bay; no beach bar confirmed.
marathias-beach-zakynthos.note: Part of the Zakynthos National Marine Park. Loggerhead turtles may be seen in the bay.

kefalos-beach-kos.access: Easy to reach from Kefalos, on foot or by short drive.
kefalos-beach-kos.parking: Free parking along the beach road.
kefalos-beach-kos.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, tavernas and water sports in season.
kefalos-beach-kos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
kefalos-beach-kos.note: Walk to the chapel on Kastri islet, and check the wind, as the bay can be breezy.

fakistra-beach-pelion.access: Leave the car on the road plateau, then walk a footpath of about 200 m to 20 minutes depending on source.
fakistra-beach-pelion.parking: Roadside parking on the plateau above the beach
fakistra-beach-pelion.food: None on the beach; food options in nearby villages.
fakistra-beach-pelion.note: Steps and tavernas belong to nearby Mylopotamos, not Fakistra. Bring water and shade.

voulisma-beach-istro.access: Paths lead down from the main road above.
voulisma-beach-istro.parking: Along the main road above the beach.
voulisma-beach-istro.sunbeds: Umbrellas and sunbeds; about EUR 15 for two sunbeds and an umbrella reported.
voulisma-beach-istro.food: Canteen at the end of the beach; Taverna Panorama nearby in Istron.
voulisma-beach-istro.note: The main strip is narrow and mostly covered by sunbeds. Showers and water sports. Also called Golden Beach.
voulisma-beach-istro.lifeguard: Lifeguard station on the main strip.

playa-de-somo-cantabria.parking: Paid car park on C. las Quebrantas, plus street parking reported
playa-de-somo-cantabria.food: Beach bars along the beach and cafes in town.
playa-de-somo-cantabria.note: Lifeguards, showers and parking listed by Spain.info. Escuela Cantabra de Surf and other schools run lessons (from about EUR 35).

playa-de-la-mata-torrevieja.access: Easy to reach from La Mata, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-la-mata-torrevieja.parking: Free and paid parking along the seafront; busy in July and August.
playa-de-la-mata-torrevieja.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, bars, restaurants, showers and lifeguards in season.
playa-de-la-mata-torrevieja.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-la-mata-torrevieja.note: Walk the promenade at sunset, and visit the salt lagoon nearby on a clear day.

torre-del-mar-beach-velez-malaga.access: Easy to reach from Torre del Mar, on foot or by short drive.
torre-del-mar-beach-velez-malaga.parking: Paid and free parking along the seafront.
torre-del-mar-beach-velez-malaga.sunbeds: Sunbeds, beach bars, chiringuitos, showers and lifeguards in season.
torre-del-mar-beach-velez-malaga.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
torre-del-mar-beach-velez-malaga.note: Try the grilled sardines at a chiringuito, and walk the promenade to the lighthouse.

algajola-beach-corsica.sunbeds: Private beach clubs rent sunbeds; bring your own on the public stretch.
algajola-beach-corsica.food: Three or four restaurants on or near the beach.
algajola-beach-corsica.note: Steep entry to the sea. One reviewer warns against leaving belongings unattended.

cargese-beach-peru-corsica.access: Easy; walk from the car park behind the dunes.
cargese-beach-peru-corsica.parking: Large free car park at the edge of the beach
cargese-beach-peru-corsica.sunbeds: Paillotes such as Laetitia and Letizia rent sunbeds and umbrellas.
cargese-beach-peru-corsica.food: Paillotes serve light meals and salads; beach restaurants and bars.
cargese-beach-peru-corsica.note: First aid station. No public toilets or bins reported. Shallow water; jellyfish and litter after storms reported.

sagone-beach-corsica.access: Easy to reach from Sagone, on foot or by short drive.
sagone-beach-corsica.parking: Free parking along the seafront and near the tower.
sagone-beach-corsica.sunbeds: Sunbeds, bars, restaurants and water sports in season.
sagone-beach-corsica.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
sagone-beach-corsica.note: Walk to the Genoese tower on the point, and visit in the evening for the light over the gulf.

ile-rousse-beach-corsica.access: Easy to reach from L Ile-Rousse, on foot or by short drive.
ile-rousse-beach-corsica.parking: Paid and free parking in town and along the seafront.
ile-rousse-beach-corsica.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, cafes, restaurants and showers in season.
ile-rousse-beach-corsica.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
ile-rousse-beach-corsica.note: Walk out to the islet and its lighthouse, and visit the covered market in the town square.

scivu-beach-sardinia.access: From the SS126 near Arbus follow the signs onto a narrow, partly unpaved track for about 13 km to the car park, then walk a few hundred metres along a wooden walkway through the dunes.
scivu-beach-sardinia.parking: Gravel lot of about 70 spaces; one visitor paid EUR 15 for the day (8am to 8pm), free at night. No toilets reported at the lot.
scivu-beach-sardinia.sunbeds: Umbrellas can be rented at the kiosk near the beach.
scivu-beach-sardinia.food: Kiosk and a restaurant by the beach, plus a snack bar up some steps; freshwater showers in summer.
scivu-beach-sardinia.note: The beach is fully exposed to the mistral, so check the wind before swimming and stay on the dune walkway.

mazzaro-beach-taormina.access: Easy to reach from Mazzaro, on foot or by short drive.
mazzaro-beach-taormina.parking: Paid parking near the bay; the cable car runs from Taormina.
mazzaro-beach-taormina.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, beach clubs, cafes and restaurants in season.
mazzaro-beach-taormina.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
mazzaro-beach-taormina.note: Take the cable car down from Taormina, and bring water shoes for the pebbles.

noli-beach-liguria.access: Easy to reach from Noli, on foot or by short drive.
noli-beach-liguria.parking: Paid parking in town and near the seafront.
noli-beach-liguria.sunbeds: Free and paid sections with sunbeds, cafes and restaurants in season.
noli-beach-liguria.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
noli-beach-liguria.note: Eat fresh fish in the old town, and walk the coast path to nearby coves.

numana-beach-marche.access: Park in Numana and walk down; Spiaggiola is reached by path or shuttle.
numana-beach-marche.parking: Park in Numana town and walk or take the shuttle
numana-beach-marche.sunbeds: Lidos rent umbrellas and sunbeds; front rows cost more and are often reserved.
numana-beach-marche.food: Restaurant at Spiaggiola; bars at the lidos.
numana-beach-marche.note: Showers and changing rooms at the lidos. Spiaggiola gets crowded in peak season.

lerici-beach-liguria.access: Easy to reach from Lerici, on foot or by short drive.
lerici-beach-liguria.parking: Paid parking near the harbour; limited in July and August.
lerici-beach-liguria.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, cafes and restaurants in season.
lerici-beach-liguria.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
lerici-beach-liguria.note: Visit the castle above the harbour, and take a boat to the villages of the Cinque Terre.

praia-dos-salgados-albufeira.access: Easy; flat access from the car park.
praia-dos-salgados-albufeira.parking: Large car park on the west side beside the lagoon
praia-dos-salgados-albufeira.food: Os Salgados restaurant right on the sand.
praia-dos-salgados-albufeira.note: Blue Flag, lifeguards in bathing season, showers and toilets. Salgados Lagoon behind the dunes is a bird site.

praia-de-melides-alentejo.access: Sand strip between the sea and the Melides lagoon; the lagoon is used for paddleboarding and kayaking.
praia-de-melides-alentejo.parking: Free parking; fills on summer weekends. Melides village is about 4 km away.
praia-de-melides-alentejo.food: A beachside restaurant usually operates in summer.
praia-de-melides-alentejo.note: Blue Flag and lifeguard listings exist but are ambiguous; verify locally. Good for birdwatching.

praia-de-galapos-arrabida.access: Steps lead down to a small cove.
praia-de-galapos-arrabida.parking: Tight and hard on summer weekends. Cars are restricted until 15 September under the Arrabida sem Carros program.
praia-de-galapos-arrabida.note: Some sources mix up Galapos with neighbouring Galapinhos.

prasonisi-beach-rhodes.access: Reached by car at the end of the road; buses run in summer (check timetables).
prasonisi-beach-rhodes.parking: Informal free parking at the end of the road; rough access road
prasonisi-beach-rhodes.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent (one source).
prasonisi-beach-rhodes.food: Tavernas and restaurants at the entrance; bring a picnic.
prasonisi-beach-rhodes.note: Wind and kite surfing centres rent boards, sails and wetsuits and give lessons. One side is windy and choppy, the other calmer. Toilets and showers are limited.

myrtiotissa-beach-corfu.access: Steep rock steps from the road, about 250-500 m. Do not drive down without a 4x4.
myrtiotissa-beach-corfu.parking: Small lots near Elia Taverna; no dedicated car park.
myrtiotissa-beach-corfu.food: Small kiosk or canteen reported; sources differ.
myrtiotissa-beach-corfu.note: Naturist beach with no natural shade. Crowded in summer and not suited to families.

liapades-beach-corfu.access: Easy to reach from Liapades, on foot or by short drive.
liapades-beach-corfu.parking: Parking above the beach and along the access road.
liapades-beach-corfu.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols and tavernas in season.
liapades-beach-corfu.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
liapades-beach-corfu.note: Combine it with a boat trip from nearby Paleokastritsa, and bring water shoes for the pebbles.

myrtos-beach-ierapetra.access: Easy to reach from Myrtos, on foot or by short drive.
myrtos-beach-ierapetra.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, tavernas and cafes in season.
myrtos-beach-ierapetra.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
myrtos-beach-ierapetra.note: Bring water shoes for the pebbles, and check the wind, as the south coast can be breezy.

psarou-beach-mykonos.access: Easy to reach from Psarou, on foot or by short drive.
psarou-beach-mykonos.parking: Paid parking near the beach; spaces fill early in summer.
psarou-beach-mykonos.sunbeds: Beach clubs, sunbeds, parasols, restaurants and water sports.
psarou-beach-mykonos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
psarou-beach-mykonos.note: Book a sunbed in advance in July and August, and visit in June or September for a quieter beach.

sant-andrea-beach-elba.access: Easy to reach by road; beach is a mix of sand and rocks.
sant-andrea-beach-elba.parking: Small free car park about 200 m away; a private paid lot is closer (about EUR 14 per day, reported)
sant-andrea-beach-elba.sunbeds: Paid sunbeds and umbrellas at the lidos; free stretches remain.
sant-andrea-beach-elba.food: A beach bar and eateries at the lidos.
sant-andrea-beach-elba.note: Lifeguard in season. Arrive early; the car parks fill fast.

capo-vaticano-beach-calabria.access: Steps lead down from the road.
capo-vaticano-beach-calabria.parking: Public and private parking nearby (reported for the area).
capo-vaticano-beach-calabria.note: Details for this exact beach are not confirmed; most sources cover neighbouring beaches.

varigotti-beach-liguria.access: Easy; walk along the village seafront.
varigotti-beach-liguria.parking: Few real car parks; arrive early or walk from Finalborgo or Noli
varigotti-beach-liguria.sunbeds: Lidos charge about EUR 20-65 for an umbrella and two sunbeds (reported); Baia dei Saraceni has free open space.
varigotti-beach-liguria.food: Bagni Al Saraceno has a bar and restaurant; village cafes.
varigotti-beach-liguria.note: Baia dei Saraceni lies inside the Bergeggi regional park area. Public transport reaches the village.

bergeggi-beach-liguria.access: Easy to reach from Bergeggi, on foot or by short drive.
bergeggi-beach-liguria.parking: Paid parking in the village and near the seafront.
bergeggi-beach-liguria.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, a few beach clubs and restaurants in season.
bergeggi-beach-liguria.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
bergeggi-beach-liguria.note: Bring water shoes for the pebbles, and take a boat or kayak to the marine reserve.

chiaia-di-luna-beach-ponza.access: Land access is closed: the tunnel has been shut after rockfalls. The beach is seen from boats or from the cliffs.
chiaia-di-luna-beach-ponza.note: Italian news reports say the tunnel is closed and no reopening date was found. Check with the Ponza municipality before planning a visit.

praia-da-senhora-da-rocha-porches.access: Drive to the car park on the cliff top beside the chapel; the beach lies below, between the headland and Praia Nova.
praia-da-senhora-da-rocha-porches.parking: Car park on top of the cliffs; one blogger found it free, but check locally.
praia-da-senhora-da-rocha-porches.food: Restaurante Vilarinho is on the beach and serves fresh fish; there is also a beach bar.
praia-da-senhora-da-rocha-porches.note: Lifeguard, toilets and showers in season. The 14th century chapel stands on the headland, and boats leave from the beach for trips to nearby grottoes.

praia-de-afife-viana-do-castelo.access: Easy to reach from Afife, on foot or by short drive.
praia-de-afife-viana-do-castelo.sunbeds: Lifeguards in summer, a beach bar and surf school in season.
praia-de-afife-viana-do-castelo.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-de-afife-viana-do-castelo.note: Swim only where lifeguards are on duty, and bring a warm layer, as the Atlantic breeze can be cool.

praia-da-cordoama-vila-do-bispo.access: Tarred access road ends at the beach.
praia-da-cordoama-vila-do-bispo.parking: Fairly large car park; tight on summer weekends
praia-da-cordoama-vila-do-bispo.food: Small beach bar and restaurant by the car park; hours shift out of season.
praia-da-cordoama-vila-do-bispo.note: Blue Flag and seasonal lifeguards. Strong waves suit surfing, not swimming; rocks on shore and in the water. Surf schools operate.

medena-beach-seget-vranjica.access: Easy to reach from Medena, on foot or by short drive.
medena-beach-seget-vranjica.parking: Paid parking nearby; limited in July and August.
medena-beach-seget-vranjica.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, cafes, restaurants and water sports in season.
medena-beach-seget-vranjica.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.

trpanj-beach-peljesac.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
trpanj-beach-peljesac.note: Wear water shoes on the pebbles, and take the ferry to Ploce for a day trip.

cala-gracio-ibiza.access: Easy to reach from Cala Gracio, on foot or by short drive.

cala-gracio-ibiza.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
cala-gracio-ibiza.note: Visit in the evening for the sunset, and bring water shoes for the rocks.

sa-tuna-beach-begur.access: On foot from nearby coves: Aiguafreda is about 10 minutes away and Ses Negres about 17.
sa-tuna-beach-begur.food: Hotel Sa Tuna has a restaurant by the beach.
sa-tuna-beach-begur.note: Small cove with a hotel on the front.

plage-de-sana-banyuls-sur-mer.access: Easy to reach from Banyuls-sur-Mer, on foot or by short drive.

plage-de-sana-banyuls-sur-mer.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-sana-banyuls-sur-mer.note: Walk the coast path toward the marine reserve, and try the local sweet wine in town.

cerbere-beach-pyrenees-orientales.access: Easy to reach from Cerbere, on foot or by short drive.
cerbere-beach-pyrenees-orientales.parking: Parking near the seafront and in the village.
cerbere-beach-pyrenees-orientales.sunbeds: Cafes and restaurants nearby; few facilities on the beach.
cerbere-beach-pyrenees-orientales.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
cerbere-beach-pyrenees-orientales.note: Bring water shoes for the pebbles, and a mask for snorkelling along the rocks.

saint-cyprien-beach-pyrenees-orientales.access: Easy to reach from Saint-Cyprien, on foot or by short drive.

saint-cyprien-beach-pyrenees-orientales.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
saint-cyprien-beach-pyrenees-orientales.note: Walk or cycle the promenade, and visit in June or September for a quieter beach.

pornic-beach-loire-atlantique.access: Easy to reach from Pornic, on foot or by short drive.
pornic-beach-loire-atlantique.parking: Paid parking near the port; limited in July and August.

pornic-beach-loire-atlantique.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
pornic-beach-loire-atlantique.note: Check the tide before you swim, and eat fresh fish at a harbour restaurant.

plage-des-dames-noirmoutier.access: Flat approach. A free Gratibus shuttle runs from the Noirmoutier-en-l Ile bus station about every 15 minutes, or you can cycle.
plage-des-dames-noirmoutier.parking: Hard in summer. Paid car park on Avenue Georges Clemenceau (17 spaces, 10:00-20:00 in season); free street parking if you arrive early.
plage-des-dames-noirmoutier.food: No restaurant on the beach; shops, restaurants and bars in town about 400 m away.
plage-des-dames-noirmoutier.note: Known for its retro beach cabins and the pier.

plage-de-caroual-erquy.access: Easy; short walk from the car park.
plage-de-caroual-erquy.parking: Parking by the beach; details not confirmed
plage-de-caroual-erquy.food: A restaurant among the beach services; crepes and snacks nearby.
plage-de-caroual-erquy.note: Official tourism site: family beach, lifeguard post during opening hours, dogs banned 15 May to 15 September.

wissant-beach-cote-d-opale.access: Flat beach about 12 km long, good for kitesurfing and windsurfing.
wissant-beach-cote-d-opale.parking: Not confirmed; beach car parks not found in sources
wissant-beach-cote-d-opale.food: Seafood and vegetarian restaurants in the village.
wissant-beach-cote-d-opale.note: Several kitesurf schools; a lesson is around EUR 130. A motorhome area is in the village.

pomena-beach-mljet.access: Easy to reach from Pomena, on foot or by short drive.

pomena-beach-mljet.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
pomena-beach-mljet.note: Buy the park ticket and walk or cycle to the lakes, and wear water shoes on the rocks.

srebreno-beach-dubrovnik-riviera.access: Easy to reach from Srebreno, on foot or by short drive.
