srebreno-beach-dubrovnik-riviera.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
srebreno-beach-dubrovnik-riviera.note: Wear water shoes on the pebbles, and take a local bus to Dubrovnik old town.

viganj-beach-peljesac.access: Easy to reach from Viganj, on foot or by short drive.
viganj-beach-peljesac.sunbeds: Windsurf and kite schools, cafes and restaurants in season.
viganj-beach-peljesac.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
viganj-beach-peljesac.note: Visit in the afternoon for the wind if you surf, and in the morning for calmer swimming.

igrane-beach-makarska-riviera.access: Easy to reach from Igrane, on foot or by short drive.
igrane-beach-makarska-riviera.parking: Free parking near the harbour and the beach.
igrane-beach-makarska-riviera.sunbeds: A few cafes and restaurants; sunbeds in season.
igrane-beach-makarska-riviera.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
igrane-beach-makarska-riviera.note: Wear water shoes on the pebbles, and take a short drive to nearby coves.

soverato-beach-calabria.access: Easy to reach from Soverato, on foot or by short drive.
soverato-beach-calabria.parking: Paid parking in town and along the seafront.
soverato-beach-calabria.sunbeds: Beach clubs, sunbeds, parasols, bars and restaurants in season.
soverato-beach-calabria.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
soverato-beach-calabria.note: Visit in June or September for calmer beaches, and walk the promenade in the evening.

punta-secca-beach-sicily.access: Easy to reach from Punta Secca, on foot or by short drive.
punta-secca-beach-sicily.sunbeds: A few beach bars, sunbeds and fish restaurants in season.
punta-secca-beach-sicily.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
punta-secca-beach-sicily.note: Eat fresh fish in the village, and visit in the evening for the sunset light on the lighthouse.

xlendi-bay-gozo.access: Easy; flat promenade, small pebble beach.
xlendi-bay-gozo.parking: Small free area plus street parking; tight in peak season
xlendi-bay-gozo.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas often for rent (unconfirmed).
xlendi-bay-gozo.food: Waterfront restaurants such as Ta Karolina.
xlendi-bay-gozo.note: Swimmers also use the flat rocks on either side. Much quieter outside summer.

kapsali-beach-kythira.access: Easy to reach from Kapsali, on foot or by short drive.
kapsali-beach-kythira.parking: Parking along the seafront and near the harbour.
kapsali-beach-kythira.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, cafes and tavernas in season.
kapsali-beach-kythira.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
kapsali-beach-kythira.note: Walk up to the castle of Chora for the view of both bays, and visit in the evening for the light.

dafni-beach-zakynthos.access: Rough access road reported; improved in recent years.
dafni-beach-zakynthos.parking: Parking at the end of the track; a reviewer reported pressure from touts
dafni-beach-zakynthos.sunbeds: Sunbeds at the tavern; reports of EUR 10 to EUR 30 per pair.
dafni-beach-zakynthos.food: Dafni taverna serves food; reviewers praise the moussaka.
dafni-beach-zakynthos.note: Inside the National Marine Park; Caretta caretta turtles nest here, so keep noise and lights down.

fava-beach-vourvourou.access: Drive to within about 50 m of the beach; the walk is under two minutes.
fava-beach-vourvourou.parking: Free parking reported by one source, paid by another; check locally
fava-beach-vourvourou.food: No bar; bring food and water.
fava-beach-vourvourou.note: Unorganised beach. Natural shade only in the afternoon. A Greek Herald report says part of the beach was set for auction; check the current status.

piana-di-mattinata-beach-puglia.access: Easy to reach from Mattinata, on foot or by short drive.
piana-di-mattinata-beach-puglia.parking: Paid and free parking along the seafront road.
piana-di-mattinata-beach-puglia.sunbeds: Beach clubs, free sections, sunbeds, bars and restaurants in season.
piana-di-mattinata-beach-puglia.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
piana-di-mattinata-beach-puglia.note: Book a boat trip to the Baia delle Zagare, and visit in June or September for a quieter beach.

is-aruttas-beach-sardinia.access: Short walk from the car park.
is-aruttas-beach-sardinia.parking: Paid, about EUR 2.50-3 per hour reported; tickets are checked quickly.
is-aruttas-beach-sardinia.sunbeds: Bring your own umbrella; no fee to use the sand was reported.
is-aruttas-beach-sardinia.food: Bar and restaurants near the beach, close to the tower.
is-aruttas-beach-sardinia.note: Quartz sand like rice grains; taking sand is prohibited and fined. Free shower area reported.

metaponto-beach-basilicata.access: Easy to reach from Lido di Metaponto, on foot or by short drive.
metaponto-beach-basilicata.parking: Free and paid parking behind the dunes.
metaponto-beach-basilicata.sunbeds: Beach clubs, sunbeds, bars and restaurants in season.
metaponto-beach-basilicata.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
metaponto-beach-basilicata.note: Visit the Tavole Palatine temple ruins, and use the pine wood for shade in the afternoon.

okrug-gornji-beach-ciovo.access: Easy to reach from Okrug Gornji, on foot or by short drive.
okrug-gornji-beach-ciovo.parking: Paid parking near the seafront; limited in July and August.
okrug-gornji-beach-ciovo.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, cafes, restaurants and water sports in season.
okrug-gornji-beach-ciovo.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
okrug-gornji-beach-ciovo.note: Wear water shoes on the pebbles, and take a short boat or bus ride to Trogir.

trstenik-beach-peljesac.access: Easy to reach from Trstenik, on foot or by short drive.
trstenik-beach-peljesac.sunbeds: A few cafes and restaurants; limited facilities on the beach.
trstenik-beach-peljesac.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
trstenik-beach-peljesac.note: Wear water shoes on the pebbles, and visit a local winery on the way.

znjan-beach-split.access: Easy to reach from Znjan, on foot or by short drive.
znjan-beach-split.parking: Paid parking nearby; city bus from Split centre.
znjan-beach-split.sunbeds: Sunbeds, cafes, showers, sports areas and water sports in season.
znjan-beach-split.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
znjan-beach-split.note: Wear water shoes on the pebbles, and visit in the morning before the beach fills.

stobrec-beach-split.access: Easy to reach from Stobrec, on foot or by short drive.
stobrec-beach-split.parking: Free and paid parking in the village.
stobrec-beach-split.sunbeds: A few cafes and restaurants; sunbeds in season.
stobrec-beach-split.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
stobrec-beach-split.note: Wear water shoes on the pebbles, and eat fresh fish at a harbour restaurant.

playa-de-sancti-petri-chiclana.access: Flat Atlantic beach; the canal side is calmer.
playa-de-sancti-petri-chiclana.parking: Roadside parking and official car parks behind the dunes; a summer lot of about 400 spaces was planned
playa-de-sancti-petri-chiclana.food: Chiringuitos on the sand (about two at Sancti Petri, 14 at neighbouring La Barrosa).
playa-de-sancti-petri-chiclana.note: Lifeguards in peak season. Showers and toilets. Very busy in July and August.

playa-de-salobrena-granada.access: Easy to reach from Salobrena, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-salobrena-granada.parking: Free and paid parking behind the beach.
playa-de-salobrena-granada.sunbeds: Chiringuitos, sunbeds, showers and a promenade in season.
playa-de-salobrena-granada.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-salobrena-granada.note: Visit the castle in the morning, and eat grilled sardines at a chiringuito.

saint-cast-beach-brittany.access: Easy; flat sand next to the car park.
saint-cast-beach-brittany.parking: Free car park a few steps from the sand; two spaces for reduced mobility
saint-cast-beach-brittany.food: No beach restaurant found; snack bar at the nearby campsite.
saint-cast-beach-brittany.note: Supervised beach, over 1 km of fine sand. Beach club, sailing courses and boat rental. Bus 214 stops at Pen Guen plage.

playa-de-poo-llanes.access: Easy by car or on foot from Poo village.
playa-de-poo-llanes.parking: Small car park that fills quickly
playa-de-poo-llanes.food: A chiringuito or restaurant on the beach.
playa-de-poo-llanes.note: Showers and a rescue service listed. Width varies from about 300 m at low tide to 30 m at high tide.

playa-de-vega-ribadesella.access: Walk from the campsite car park; about 400 m on a shaded path.
playa-de-vega-ribadesella.parking: Basic parking; campsite charges for its own lot
playa-de-vega-ribadesella.food: Bars and cafes on the sand; campsite bar and restaurant.
playa-de-vega-ribadesella.note: Toilets and showers reported. Camping Playa de Vega sits behind the beach (closed mid-September to mid-June).

playa-de-la-ballota-llanes.access: Small unpaved path down to the beach; access can be challenging.
playa-de-la-ballota-llanes.parking: A small lot above the beach is reported blocked with rocks; a few road-bend spaces
playa-de-la-ballota-llanes.food: A restaurant on site reported by one source.
playa-de-la-ballota-llanes.note: Early arrival advised because of limited parking.

playa-de-barayo-valdes.access: Forest path of about 800 m from the car park, or stairs at the west end. A second access starts at Sabugo.
playa-de-barayo-valdes.parking: Sources disagree: a car park near the top is reported, but one official source says there is none.
playa-de-barayo-valdes.food: None on the beach; the fishing village of Puerto de Vega is about 5 km west.
playa-de-barayo-valdes.note: Inside a partial nature reserve of dunes, marshes and river. Nudism is tolerated in the east. Swells can be strong.

playa-de-liencres-cantabria.access: Short walk from the car park. The dunes are protected, so stay on the paths.
playa-de-liencres-cantabria.parking: Large car park that fills on summer weekends; arrive early.
playa-de-liencres-cantabria.note: Surf school and showers. Best for intermediate surfers. Inside the Dunas de Liencres Natural Park.

praia-de-pantin-valdovino.parking: Free parking; about 10 spaces in the motorhome area
praia-de-pantin-valdovino.food: Restaurant at nearby Apartamentos Las Olas, about 100 m away.
praia-de-pantin-valdovino.note: Expert-level surf with strong rips; showers and a lifeguard reported. Several surf camps nearby.

plage-du-val-andre-brittany.parking: Car park a few minutes away at the small rocky Plage du Val
plage-du-val-andre-brittany.note: Sand over 2.5 km bordered by a pedestrian dyke. Rock formations show at low tide; the sea withdraws far.

plage-de-pornichet-loire-atlantique.access: Easy to reach from Pornichet, on foot or by short drive.
plage-de-pornichet-loire-atlantique.sunbeds: Beach clubs, sailing schools, cafes and showers in season.
plage-de-pornichet-loire-atlantique.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-pornichet-loire-atlantique.note: Check the tide before you swim, and walk the promenade toward La Baule.

plage-de-saint-aubin-sur-mer-normandy.access: Easy to reach from Saint-Aubin-sur-Mer, on foot or by short drive.
plage-de-saint-aubin-sur-mer-normandy.parking: Free and paid parking along the seafront.
plage-de-saint-aubin-sur-mer-normandy.sunbeds: Beach huts, a sailing school, cafes and showers in season.
plage-de-saint-aubin-sur-mer-normandy.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-saint-aubin-sur-mer-normandy.note: Visit the memorials near the shore, and check the tide before you swim.

plage-de-ouistreham-normandy.access: Easy to reach from Ouistreham, on foot or by short drive.
plage-de-ouistreham-normandy.parking: Free and paid parking along the seafront.
plage-de-ouistreham-normandy.sunbeds: Beach huts, cafes, restaurants and showers in season.
plage-de-ouistreham-normandy.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-ouistreham-normandy.note: Visit the memorials near Sword Beach, and check the tide before you swim.

baratti-beach-tuscany.access: Free public beach in a wide gulf; Baratti is easiest for parking before 10 am on weekends.
baratti-beach-tuscany.sunbeds: Paid lido Bagno Baratti (about EUR 23 for two beds and a parasol, reported); Sun Beach Baratti rents umbrellas, loungers, pedal boats, canoes and SUP.
baratti-beach-tuscany.food: Restaurants on the west side of the bay such as Canessa and Torre di Baratti.
baratti-beach-tuscany.note: Free area for your own umbrella.

campese-beach-giglio-island.access: Easy; flat; bus from Giglio Porto about every 20 minutes in summer (about EUR 2).
campese-beach-giglio-island.parking: Sports field behind the beach, about EUR 1 per hour or EUR 3 per day; blue spaces about EUR 7 per day
campese-beach-giglio-island.sunbeds: Lidos rent sunbeds and umbrellas; free stretches remain.
campese-beach-giglio-island.food: Bars and restaurants at the lidos and nearby.
campese-beach-giglio-island.note: Giglio's largest beach. Public toilets, showers and pedal boats. Costs are reported and may change.

follonica-beach-tuscany.access: Easy to reach from Follonica, on foot or by short drive.
follonica-beach-tuscany.sunbeds: Beach clubs, free sections, sunbeds, bars and restaurants in season.
follonica-beach-tuscany.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
follonica-beach-tuscany.note: Visit in June or September for a quieter beach, and walk the promenade in the evening.

xerokambos-beach-crete.access: Long, narrow road; about 90 minutes from Sitia.
xerokambos-beach-crete.parking: Small free parking area near the beach; arrive early in summer
xerokambos-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sources disagree: a few sunbeds at Long Beach or none.
xerokambos-beach-crete.food: Tavernas in the village of Xerokambos.

armier-bay-malta.access: Easy to reach from Armier, on foot or by short drive.
armier-bay-malta.parking: Free parking near the beach; busy on summer weekends.
armier-bay-malta.sunbeds: Snack bars, sunbeds and parasols in season.
armier-bay-malta.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
armier-bay-malta.note: Visit on a weekday in summer, and take the ferry from nearby Cirkewwa to Gozo.

playa-de-mazagon-huelva.access: Urban stretch is step-free; Cuesta Maneli needs a 20 minute boardwalk walk.
playa-de-mazagon-huelva.parking: Reference car park on Avenida de los Conquistadores
playa-de-mazagon-huelva.food: Chiringuito Casa Colon and others; Cuesta Maneli has chiringuitos too.
playa-de-mazagon-huelva.note: Lifeguards and showers on the urban stretch. Cuesta Maneli has no car access and lifeguard cover is unconfirmed.

playa-de-sotogrande-cadiz.access: Easy to reach from Sotogrande, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-sotogrande-cadiz.parking: Free and paid parking near the marina.
playa-de-sotogrande-cadiz.sunbeds: A beach bar, showers and a marina with cafes close by.
playa-de-sotogrande-cadiz.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-sotogrande-cadiz.note: Visit in June or September for a quieter beach, and check the wind before you go.

playa-de-castelldefels-barcelona.access: Easy to reach from Castelldefels, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-castelldefels-barcelona.parking: Paid parking near the beach; the train station is a short walk.
playa-de-castelldefels-barcelona.sunbeds: Beach bars, showers, sunbeds and lifeguards in season.
playa-de-castelldefels-barcelona.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-castelldefels-barcelona.note: Go by train from Barcelona, and visit on a weekday in summer to avoid the crowds.

playa-de-isla-canela-huelva.access: Easy to reach from Isla Canela, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-isla-canela-huelva.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds and showers in season.
playa-de-isla-canela-huelva.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-isla-canela-huelva.note: Walk to the river mouth at sunset, and cross to Portugal by ferry from Ayamonte.

praia-de-caminha-minho.access: Easy to reach from Caminha, on foot or by short drive.
praia-de-caminha-minho.parking: Free parking near the river mouth.
praia-de-caminha-minho.sunbeds: Cafes and a beach bar in season; limited facilities elsewhere.
praia-de-caminha-minho.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-de-caminha-minho.note: Visit the old town of Caminha, and swim only where the current is calm.

kalathas-beach-chania.parking: Free street parking fills fast; paid private lots about EUR 4-5
kalathas-beach-chania.sunbeds: Two sunbeds and an umbrella about EUR 15 per day (one guide).
kalathas-beach-chania.food: A taverna at the back of the beach in summer; others a short walk.
kalathas-beach-chania.note: Arrive before 11 am in July and August.

finikounda-beach-messinia.parking: Public parking not confirmed; village streets
finikounda-beach-messinia.sunbeds: Organised sections with sunbeds and umbrellas; some free with a drink.
finikounda-beach-messinia.food: Tavernas on the sand and fish restaurants in the village.
finikounda-beach-messinia.note: Windsurfing and kite spots nearby at Anemomilos and Ligonammos thanks to steady wind.

vlychada-beach-santorini.access: Easy by car or public bus; terrain is rocky.
vlychada-beach-santorini.parking: Free parking reported near the port and cafe
vlychada-beach-santorini.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent; about EUR 10 for two beds and an umbrella (reported, 2023).
vlychada-beach-santorini.food: A few tavernas above the small port and beach bars.
vlychada-beach-santorini.note: No lifeguards. Water shoes recommended. Windy in summer.

methoni-beach-messinia.access: Easy; flat sand below the castle.
methoni-beach-messinia.parking: Free parking reported near the beach; not official
methoni-beach-messinia.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas for rent; about EUR 6 reported, some free at hotels.
methoni-beach-messinia.food: A fish taverna on the beach, plus Taverna Nikos nearby.
methoni-beach-messinia.note: Crescent beach nearly 2 km long beneath the Venetian castle, with pine forest behind.

fornillo-beach-positano.access: About 10 minutes on foot from Spiaggia Grande, with stairs; not wheelchair friendly.
fornillo-beach-positano.parking: No beach parking; walk from Positano town
fornillo-beach-positano.sunbeds: Lidos rent umbrellas and loungers; free sections remain.
fornillo-beach-positano.food: Sea-view restaurants and a handful of summer beach bars.
fornillo-beach-positano.note: Public toilets and showers at the lidos. Pebbles are hard on bare feet, so water shoes help.

serapo-beach-gaeta.access: Easy to reach from Serapo, on foot or by short drive.
serapo-beach-gaeta.sunbeds: Beach clubs, sunbeds, bars and restaurants in season.
serapo-beach-gaeta.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
serapo-beach-gaeta.note: Visit in June or September for a quieter beach, and walk up to the old town in the evening.

ansedonia-beach-tuscany.access: Easy to reach from Ansedonia, on foot or by short drive.
ansedonia-beach-tuscany.sunbeds: Beach clubs, a free section, sunbeds and a few restaurants in season.
ansedonia-beach-tuscany.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
ansedonia-beach-tuscany.note: Visit the Roman ruins of Cosa on the hill, and use the free section outside high season.

bonassola-beach-liguria.access: Easy; flat access from the village.
bonassola-beach-liguria.parking: Limited parking in town; free parking reported nearby but not confirmed
bonassola-beach-liguria.sunbeds: Lidos rent sunbeds and umbrellas by the day or half day; free strips between them.
bonassola-beach-liguria.note: Free showers and toilets reported. Wider free strips lie at each end of the bay.

plage-de-gruissan-occitanie.access: Easy to reach from Gruissan, on foot or by short drive.
plage-de-gruissan-occitanie.parking: Free and paid parking behind the beach.
plage-de-gruissan-occitanie.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds, showers and water sports in season.
plage-de-gruissan-occitanie.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-gruissan-occitanie.note: Walk to the old village of Gruissan with its tower, and check the wind before you swim.

plage-des-minimes-la-rochelle.access: Easy to reach from Les Minimes, on foot or by short drive.
plage-des-minimes-la-rochelle.parking: Free and paid parking near the marina.
plage-des-minimes-la-rochelle.sunbeds: Cafes and restaurants along the marina, and showers in season.
plage-des-minimes-la-rochelle.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-des-minimes-la-rochelle.note: Cycle from the old harbour along the coast path, and check the tide before you swim.

plage-d-arcachon-gironde.access: Easy to reach from Arcachon, on foot or by short drive.
plage-d-arcachon-gironde.sunbeds: Beach cafes, showers, a promenade and a lifeguard service in season.
plage-d-arcachon-gironde.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-d-arcachon-gironde.note: Visit the Dune du Pilat nearby, and check the tide, as the water goes out far.

plage-de-la-ciotat-provence.access: Easy to reach from La Ciotat, on foot or by short drive.
plage-de-la-ciotat-provence.sunbeds: Beach clubs, cafes, showers and sunbeds in season.
plage-de-la-ciotat-provence.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-la-ciotat-provence.note: Walk to the old port at sunset, and visit the rocky coves along the coast.

plage-du-barcares-pyrenees-orientales.access: Easy to reach from Le Barcares, on foot or by short drive.
plage-du-barcares-pyrenees-orientales.sunbeds: Beach clubs, sunbeds, showers, water sports and cafes in season.
plage-du-barcares-pyrenees-orientales.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-du-barcares-pyrenees-orientales.note: Visit in June or September for a quieter beach, and look at the Pyrenees from the shore.

plage-de-valras-herault.access: Easy to reach from Valras-Plage, on foot or by short drive.
plage-de-valras-herault.sunbeds: Beach clubs, cafes, showers, sunbeds and water sports in season.
plage-de-valras-herault.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
plage-de-valras-herault.note: Visit the Canal du Midi nearby, and swim early in the day in July and August.

damouchari-beach-pelion.access: Very small car park at the top, then a staircase. Cars and campervans cannot reach the beach.
damouchari-beach-pelion.parking: Very small lot at the top.
damouchari-beach-pelion.sunbeds: Loungers under the olive trees next to the taverna for a small fee.
damouchari-beach-pelion.note: Mix of pebbles and sand with a rocky seabed. Changing cabins and a shower. A few opening scenes of Mamma Mia were shot at the harbour.

nikiana-beach-lefkada.access: Easy to reach from Nikiana, on foot or by short drive.
nikiana-beach-lefkada.sunbeds: Tavernas, sunbeds, bars and a promenade in season.
nikiana-beach-lefkada.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
nikiana-beach-lefkada.note: Visit for sunset over the mainland hills, and bring water shoes for the pebbles.

vasiliki-beach-lefkada.access: Easy from the village; two sides are 5-10 minutes apart.
vasiliki-beach-lefkada.sunbeds: Sunbeds near the busy west end and bars.
vasiliki-beach-lefkada.food: Tavernas along the harbour side; bars at the beach end.
vasiliki-beach-lefkada.note: Famed windsurf bay: gentle morning breeze and stronger afternoon wind. Rental and lessons on the sand. Grey shingle over sand.

agios-nikitas-beach-lefkada.access: Village beach reached on foot; the headland path to Mylos takes about 20 minutes and can be rough, or take the taxi boat (a couple of euros).
agios-nikitas-beach-lefkada.parking: Car parks in the village fill in July and August; the main street is pedestrian-only
agios-nikitas-beach-lefkada.sunbeds: Plenty of sunbed pairs and umbrellas for rent.
agios-nikitas-beach-lefkada.food: Several tavernas, bars and minimarkets close to the sand.

praia-de-santa-rita-torres-vedras.access: Easy to reach from Santa Rita, on foot or by short drive.
praia-de-santa-rita-torres-vedras.parking: Free car park above the beach.
praia-de-santa-rita-torres-vedras.sunbeds: A beach bar and lifeguards in season; limited facilities elsewhere.
praia-de-santa-rita-torres-vedras.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-de-santa-rita-torres-vedras.note: Swim only where lifeguards are on duty, and bring a warm layer for the Atlantic wind.

praia-de-sao-pedro-do-estoril.access: Easy to reach from Sao Pedro do Estoril, on foot or by short drive.
praia-de-sao-pedro-do-estoril.parking: Paid parking near the seafront; the train station is a short walk.
praia-de-sao-pedro-do-estoril.sunbeds: Cafes and a beach bar in season; showers and toilets nearby.
praia-de-sao-pedro-do-estoril.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-de-sao-pedro-do-estoril.note: Take the train from Lisbon, and walk the promenade toward Cascais in the evening.

praia-da-fonte-da-telha-costa-da-caparic.access: Reached by road; the mini train serves the beach.
praia-da-fonte-da-telha-costa-da-caparic.food: Restaurants and bars; each section is tied to a restaurant.
praia-da-fonte-da-telha-costa-da-caparic.note: Southern terminus of the Transpraia mini train. Nine supervised stretches. The naturist area is to the north, with parking at Bela Vista.

praia-da-lagoa-de-albufeira-sesimbra.access: Easy to reach from Lagoa de Albufeira, on foot or by short drive.
praia-da-lagoa-de-albufeira-sesimbra.parking: Free car park near the lagoon.
praia-da-lagoa-de-albufeira-sesimbra.sunbeds: Beach restaurants, a kite school and lifeguards in season.
praia-da-lagoa-de-albufeira-sesimbra.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-da-lagoa-de-albufeira-sesimbra.note: Check the wind and the waves before you swim, and try the calm lagoon with children.

praia-da-consolacao-peniche.access: Easy to reach from Consolacao, on foot or by short drive.
praia-da-consolacao-peniche.sunbeds: Beach restaurants, a surf school and lifeguards in season.
praia-da-consolacao-peniche.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-da-consolacao-peniche.note: Check the tide and the waves before you swim, and try a surf lesson on a calm day.

praia-verde-castro-marim.access: Easy to reach from Praia Verde, on foot or by short drive.
praia-verde-castro-marim.parking: Free and paid parking behind the pines.
praia-verde-castro-marim.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds, a surf school and showers in season.
praia-verde-castro-marim.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-verde-castro-marim.note: Walk through the pines to the next beaches, and bring shade at midday.

praia-da-prainha-alvor.access: Short walk from the resort; a lift is built into the complex.
praia-da-prainha-alvor.parking: Parking at the resort is for guests; public parking not confirmed
praia-da-prainha-alvor.sunbeds: A reviewer reported EUR 19 for two sunbeds in 2023.
praia-da-prainha-alvor.food: A bar and snack bar at the resort.
praia-da-prainha-alvor.note: Details for the public beach are thin; check on arrival.

praia-da-batata-lagos.access: Easy to reach from Batata, on foot or by short drive.
praia-da-batata-lagos.parking: Paid parking in the town; most visitors walk from the old town.
praia-da-batata-lagos.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds and cafes in season; showers nearby.
praia-da-batata-lagos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-da-batata-lagos.note: Walk through the tunnel from the old town, and swim in the morning before the crowds.

playa-de-santa-ponsa-mallorca.access: Easy to reach from Santa Ponsa, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-santa-ponsa-mallorca.parking: Free and paid parking behind the beach.
playa-de-santa-ponsa-mallorca.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, water sports, showers and cafes in season.
playa-de-santa-ponsa-mallorca.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-santa-ponsa-mallorca.note: Walk to the pine headland at the end of the bay, and visit in June or September.

vignanotica-beach-gargano.access: Two ways in: a paid car park near the bay with a stairway or shuttle down, or the 2.5 to 3 km Mergoli-Vignanotica trail from the SP53 between Vieste and Mattinata (unpaved, wear sturdy shoes).
vignanotica-beach-gargano.parking: Paid lots near the bay (one visitor reported EUR 10); only a few spaces at the trailhead.
vignanotica-beach-gargano.sunbeds: Lidos with sunbeds operate in peak summer; the beach is quiet the rest of the year.
vignanotica-beach-gargano.food: Toilets and refreshment points in summer.
vignanotica-beach-gargano.note: About 500 m of sand and pebbles below steep white cliffs with caves. The beach is on the border of Vieste and Mattinata.

praia-a-mare-beach-calabria.access: Easy to reach from Praia a Mare, on foot or by short drive.
praia-a-mare-beach-calabria.sunbeds: Beach clubs, sunbeds, bars and restaurants in season.
praia-a-mare-beach-calabria.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-a-mare-beach-calabria.note: Take a boat trip to the island of Dino and its sea caves, and visit in June or September.

acciaroli-beach-cilento.access: Easy to reach from Acciaroli, on foot or by short drive.
acciaroli-beach-cilento.parking: Paid parking at the edge of the village.
acciaroli-beach-cilento.sunbeds: Beach clubs, a free section, cafes and restaurants in season.
acciaroli-beach-cilento.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
acciaroli-beach-cilento.note: Walk the lanes of the old village in the evening, and try fresh fish in the harbour.

trentova-beach-agropoli.access: Easy to reach from Trentova, on foot or by short drive.
trentova-beach-agropoli.parking: Paid and free parking near the beach.
trentova-beach-agropoli.sunbeds: Beach clubs, a free section, sunbeds, bars and restaurants in season.
trentova-beach-agropoli.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
trentova-beach-agropoli.note: Combine the beach with a visit to the temples of Paestum, and go in June or September.

marina-del-cantone-beach-nerano.access: Down from Nerano by road or in summer by shuttle from Sant Agata.
marina-del-cantone-beach-nerano.parking: Paid parking about EUR 10 per day (reported); summer shuttle from Sant Agata
marina-del-cantone-beach-nerano.sunbeds: Concessions rent umbrellas and sunbeds; free beach too.
marina-del-cantone-beach-nerano.food: Restaurants on the beach, such as Taverna del Capitano.
marina-del-cantone-beach-nerano.note: Pebble beach. Spaghetti alla Nerano is the local dish. Bathing season runs about April to October.

le-bombarde-beach-alghero.access: Beach 7-10 km north of Alghero in Porto Conte Natural Park; local buses run from Alghero.
le-bombarde-beach-alghero.parking: Paid parking in peak season (free after 9 pm, reported)
le-bombarde-beach-alghero.sunbeds: J&B beach club rents sunbeds, umbrellas and hammocks.
le-bombarde-beach-alghero.food: Beach clubs, restaurants and bars; reviews of the J&B restaurant are mixed.
le-bombarde-beach-alghero.note: Large free areas remain. Busiest 11:00-16:00 in July and August.

santa-maria-navarrese-beach-ogliastra.parking: Free parking reported, hard to find in summer
santa-maria-navarrese-beach-ogliastra.sunbeds: A sunbed area with umbrellas, plus a free section.
santa-maria-navarrese-beach-ogliastra.food: Bars and kiosks on the strand.
santa-maria-navarrese-beach-ogliastra.note: Toilets and showers reported. Rocky patches and deep water, so not ideal for small children.

isola-rossa-beach-sardinia.access: Easy to reach from Isola Rossa, on foot or by short drive.
isola-rossa-beach-sardinia.sunbeds: Beach clubs, a few cafes and restaurants in season; harbour services.
isola-rossa-beach-sardinia.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
isola-rossa-beach-sardinia.note: Walk to the tower on the red island at sunset, and swim from the rocks beside the beach.

solanas-beach-sardinia.parking: Free parking close by; a quieter lot at the east end
solanas-beach-sardinia.sunbeds: Kiosks rent umbrellas, loungers, pedal boats and SUPs.
solanas-beach-sardinia.food: Several bars on the beach in summer.
solanas-beach-sardinia.note: About 1 km of sand. Services run June to September.

cala-mari-pintau-sardinia.access: Short walk along a vegetated path from the road.
cala-mari-pintau-sardinia.parking: Free roadside parking with no equipped car park; arrive before 10 am in high season
cala-mari-pintau-sardinia.food: Kiosk-bar and a small cafe on the path; toilets.
cala-mari-pintau-sardinia.note: Blue Flag for several years. Mostly pebbles with fine white sand further out. About 20 km from Cagliari.

li-mindi-beach-badesi.access: About 50 m on foot through dunes from the car park.
li-mindi-beach-badesi.parking: Large car park behind the dunes; cheap per day
li-mindi-beach-badesi.sunbeds: No concessions here; rentals at Li Junchi, the central beach.
li-mindi-beach-badesi.note: Undeveloped dune beach; bring your own shade. Seaweed and strong currents reported at times.

portixeddu-beach-buggerru.access: Flat, with high dunes behind parts of the beach.
portixeddu-beach-buggerru.parking: Parking available, free entry; capacity not confirmed
portixeddu-beach-buggerru.sunbeds: Beach equipment, canoe and pedalo rental.
portixeddu-beach-buggerru.note: Strong currents on this coast; take care when swimming. A pine grove with picnic areas sits behind the beach. Buggerru is about 6 km away.

palasa-beach-albanian-riviera.access: Turnoff from the SH8 just below the Llogara Pass tunnel, about 8 km north of Dhermi.
palasa-beach-albanian-riviera.sunbeds: Paid club sections; sets reported at EUR 8-25, sources disagree.
palasa-beach-albanian-riviera.note: Free public stretches at the edges of the 1.5 km beach. Club sections fill in July and August. Prices come mainly from one local site.

golem-beach-albania.access: Easy to reach from Golem, on foot or by short drive.
golem-beach-albania.parking: Free and paid parking along the road behind the beach.
golem-beach-albania.sunbeds: Cafes, sunbeds, umbrellas and restaurants in season.
golem-beach-albania.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
golem-beach-albania.note: Visit on a weekday in summer to avoid the weekend crowds, and bring sun protection.

lalzit-bay-beach-albania.access: Easy to reach from Lalzit Bay, on foot or by short drive.
lalzit-bay-beach-albania.parking: Free and paid parking behind the beach.
lalzit-bay-beach-albania.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds, umbrellas, hotels and restaurants in season.
lalzit-bay-beach-albania.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
lalzit-bay-beach-albania.note: Visit in June or September for a quieter beach, and take a taxi from Tirana airport.

rafailovici-beach-budva-riviera.access: Easy to reach from Rafailovici, on foot or by short drive.
rafailovici-beach-budva-riviera.parking: Paid parking in the village; a short walk to the beach.
rafailovici-beach-budva-riviera.sunbeds: Beach clubs, sunbeds, cafes, restaurants and water sports in season.
rafailovici-beach-budva-riviera.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
rafailovici-beach-budva-riviera.note: Walk the promenade to Becici, and visit in June or September to avoid the crowds.

ada-bojana-beach-montenegro.access: Flat, on the island at the Bojana river mouth.
ada-bojana-beach-montenegro.parking: Reports differ: EUR 5 per car, or EUR 2 per hour up to EUR 10 per day
ada-bojana-beach-montenegro.sunbeds: Two chairs and an umbrella about EUR 15 (July 2025 report); towel space is free.
ada-bojana-beach-montenegro.food: Beach bars and restaurants close by.
ada-bojana-beach-montenegro.note: The organised nudist section charges entry. Check prices on arrival.

marsaskala-bay-malta.access: Easy to reach from Marsaskala, on foot or by short drive.
marsaskala-bay-malta.parking: Free street parking along the promenade.
marsaskala-bay-malta.sunbeds: Cafes, restaurants, a promenade and a small beach area.
marsaskala-bay-malta.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
marsaskala-bay-malta.note: Eat fresh fish on the waterfront, and swim from the steps early in the morning.

drvenik-beach-dalmatia.access: Easy; two bays near the ferry port.
drvenik-beach-dalmatia.food: Konobas nearby such as Konoba Jelas and Caffe Bar Lanterna.
drvenik-beach-dalmatia.note: Ferry to Hvar leaves from the village. Donja vala and Gornja vala are the two bays.

zivogosce-beach-makarska-riviera.access: Easy to reach from Zivogosce, on foot or by short drive.
zivogosce-beach-makarska-riviera.sunbeds: Beach bars, sunbeds, cafes and restaurants in season.
zivogosce-beach-makarska-riviera.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
zivogosce-beach-makarska-riviera.note: Walk the promenade in the evening, and take a day trip to Biokovo Nature Park.

costa-calma-beach-fuerteventura.access: Long sheltered white-sand beach beside hotels; windy Sotavento is a short drive away.
costa-calma-beach-fuerteventura.food: Restaurants and shops in the nearby shopping centre; hotel cafes and bars.
costa-calma-beach-fuerteventura.note: Lifeguard cover and water activities in season.

playa-de-amadores-gran-canaria.parking: Street parking behind the beach (free and paid options reported)
playa-de-amadores-gran-canaria.sunbeds: Sunbeds and parasols for rent; about EUR 15 for two plus parasol.
playa-de-amadores-gran-canaria.food: Restaurants, snack bars and bars along the beach.
playa-de-amadores-gran-canaria.note: Blue Flag and lifeguards. Toilets about EUR 0.70, showers EUR 2, lockers EUR 1.50. Wheelchair access aids.

playa-del-ingles-gran-canaria.sunbeds: Sunbed rental, about EUR 7.50 for two with an umbrella (reported).
playa-del-ingles-gran-canaria.note: Lifeguards and showers (no soap) at entrances. Promenade toilets charge a fee. Gentle slope suits limited mobility.

playa-de-mogan-gran-canaria.access: Easy; small beach beside the marina.
playa-de-mogan-gran-canaria.sunbeds: Sunbeds, sunshades, pedalos and canoes for hire.
playa-de-mogan-gran-canaria.food: Kiosks plus port restaurants such as Belin and Fragata II.
playa-de-mogan-gran-canaria.note: Calm sheltered beach by Puerto de Mogan.

playa-de-el-medano-tenerife.sunbeds: Sun loungers and parasols for hire.
playa-de-el-medano-tenerife.food: Bars and restaurants; El Cabezo kiosk serves light food.
playa-de-el-medano-tenerife.note: Lifeguards, showers, toilets. A kitesurf zone with schools and rentals; the kite area is too windy for casual sunbathing.

playa-de-los-cristianos-tenerife.access: Easy to reach from Los Cristianos, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-los-cristianos-tenerife.parking: Paid parking in the town and near the port.
playa-de-los-cristianos-tenerife.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, showers, cafes and a promenade.
playa-de-los-cristianos-tenerife.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-los-cristianos-tenerife.note: Take a ferry to La Gomera for a day trip, and walk the promenade in the evening.

playa-de-las-americas-tenerife.access: Easy to reach from Playa de las Americas, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-las-americas-tenerife.parking: Paid parking in the resort area.
playa-de-las-americas-tenerife.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, showers, bars, restaurants and water sports.
playa-de-las-americas-tenerife.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-las-americas-tenerife.note: Visit in the morning for a quieter beach, and walk the promenade to nearby beaches.

playa-de-colonia-de-sant-jordi-mallorca.access: Easy to reach from Colonia de Sant Jordi, on foot or by short drive.
playa-de-colonia-de-sant-jordi-mallorca.parking: Free and paid parking near the village.
playa-de-colonia-de-sant-jordi-mallorca.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, cafes and restaurants in season.
playa-de-colonia-de-sant-jordi-mallorca.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
playa-de-colonia-de-sant-jordi-mallorca.note: Take a boat to Cabrera island, and visit the beaches of Es Trenc nearby.

cala-ferrera-mallorca.access: Steps lead down from a small car park to the cove.
cala-ferrera-mallorca.parking: Small car park; about 100 m path from the end of Cal Petit Avenue; arrive early
cala-ferrera-mallorca.sunbeds: Loungers and parasols for rent; some spots reserved for hotel guests.
cala-ferrera-mallorca.food: Beach bar and restaurants such as Marivent.
cala-ferrera-mallorca.note: Small cove; hotel guests fill many sunbeds in season.

platja-de-portals-nous-mallorca.access: Easy to reach from Portals Nous, on foot or by short drive.
platja-de-portals-nous-mallorca.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, cafes and restaurants beside the marina.
platja-de-portals-nous-mallorca.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
platja-de-portals-nous-mallorca.note: Visit in the morning, and have lunch with a view of the yachts in the marina.

agia-anna-beach-naxos.access: Flat; about 6 km from Naxos Town, buses every half hour in season.
agia-anna-beach-naxos.parking: Public parking at many points by the sea
agia-anna-beach-naxos.sunbeds: Sunbeds and umbrellas along most of the beach; hard to get a chair after 11 am in peak season.
agia-anna-beach-naxos.food: Cafes, tavernas and beach bars line the sand.
agia-anna-beach-naxos.note: One of the best organised beaches on Naxos; mini markets and ATMs close by.

acharavi-beach-corfu.access: Easy to reach from Acharavi, on foot or by short drive.
acharavi-beach-corfu.parking: Free parking along the main road.
acharavi-beach-corfu.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, tavernas, water sports and showers in season.
acharavi-beach-corfu.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
acharavi-beach-corfu.note: Visit in June or September for a quieter beach, and take a day trip to the old town of Corfu.

ipsos-beach-corfu.access: Easy to reach from Ipsos, on foot or by short drive.
ipsos-beach-corfu.parking: Free parking along the road and in side streets.
ipsos-beach-corfu.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, tavernas, bars and water sports in season.
ipsos-beach-corfu.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
ipsos-beach-corfu.note: Bring water shoes for the pebbles, and visit in June or September for a quieter beach.

almyrida-beach-crete.access: Easy to reach from Almyrida, on foot or by short drive.
almyrida-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, tavernas, water sports and showers in season.
almyrida-beach-crete.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
almyrida-beach-crete.note: Visit in the morning for calm water, and take a day trip to the lake of Kournas nearby.

agia-pelagia-beach-crete.access: Easy to reach from Agia Pelagia, on foot or by short drive.
agia-pelagia-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, tavernas, water sports and showers in season.
agia-pelagia-beach-crete.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
agia-pelagia-beach-crete.note: Take a short drive to the village of Fodele, and swim in the morning when the bay is calm.

agia-galini-beach-crete.access: Easy to reach from Agia Galini, on foot or by short drive.
agia-galini-beach-crete.parking: Paid parking at the entrance of the village; narrow streets.
agia-galini-beach-crete.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, tavernas and harbour restaurants in season.
agia-galini-beach-crete.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
agia-galini-beach-crete.note: Take a boat to the nearby beaches, and have dinner by the harbour at sunset.

praia-de-matosinhos-porto.access: Easy to reach from Matosinhos, on foot or by short drive.
praia-de-matosinhos-porto.parking: Paid parking along the seafront; a metro line reaches the area.
praia-de-matosinhos-porto.sunbeds: Surf schools, cafes, fish restaurants and showers in season.
praia-de-matosinhos-porto.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
praia-de-matosinhos-porto.note: Eat grilled fish in a Matosinhos restaurant, and swim only where lifeguards are on duty.

praia-da-fuseta-algarve.access: Easy on the Ria side; a ferry from the marina reaches the island beach.
praia-da-fuseta-algarve.parking: About 120 spaces reported plus town parking
praia-da-fuseta-algarve.food: Marina restaurants grill fish in summer; bars on the beach.
praia-da-fuseta-algarve.note: Ria Formosa Natural Park. Seasonal lifeguards, showers and toilets; dogs barred in bathing season.

mastichari-beach-kos.access: Easy to reach from Mastichari, on foot or by short drive.
mastichari-beach-kos.parking: Free parking along the beach road.
mastichari-beach-kos.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, tavernas, water sports and showers in season.
mastichari-beach-kos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
mastichari-beach-kos.note: Take the boat to Kalymnos from the harbour, and visit in the morning when the wind is lighter.

baia-sardinia-beach.access: Beach in a resort bay on the Costa Smeralda; some nearby beaches use a dirt path of 8-10 minutes from a car park.
baia-sardinia-beach.parking: Paid and street parking in town; spaces fill early in summer
baia-sardinia-beach.sunbeds: Umbrella and lounger rental, reported as expensive.
baia-sardinia-beach.food: Bars and restaurants in town, such as Barracuda and Ristorante Baia Blu.
baia-sardinia-beach.note: Details for this exact beach are thin; check on arrival.

agios-georgios-beach-naxos.access: Easy to reach from Agios Georgios, on foot or by short drive.
agios-georgios-beach-naxos.parking: Paid and free parking near the beach; a short walk from the town.
agios-georgios-beach-naxos.sunbeds: Sunbeds, parasols, tavernas, water sports and showers in season.
agios-georgios-beach-naxos.food: Cafes, bars or restaurants are close by.
agios-georgios-beach-naxos.note: Walk from Naxos Town in 10 minutes, and visit the Portara gate at sunset.

platja-de-sant-pol-costa-brava.access: Easy; flat sand in a sheltered bay.
platja-de-sant-pol-costa-brava.note: Blue Flag, lifeguard, showers, foot wash and toilets (official listing).
